3rd-person psychological verbalizer suffix attaching to descriptive verbs via -아/어하다; converts intransitive sensory/emotion adjective into transitive action verb taking accusative -을/를 (슬프다 -> 슬퍼하다, 무섭다 -> 무서워하다, 좋아하다, 싫어하다).

Absence verb (缺席 + 하다 = to be absent); takes institution/class with allative -에 (수업에/학교에 결석하다); antonym is 출석하다 (出席하다).
Abstract noun (順序 = order / sequence / turn); collocates with 순서대로 (in order), 순서를 기다리다 (wait one's turn), 순서가 되다 (one's turn has arrived).
Academic field noun (英語學 = English linguistics); collocations: 영어학 전공 (English linguistics major), 영어학을 전공하다, 영어학개론 (introduction to English linguistics).
Academic field/major noun (computer + 工學); collocates with 전공하다 (Obj-을/를 전공하다) and 공부하다.

Academic financial noun (登錄金 = tuition fee / registration fee); typically paired with verb 내다 (등록금을 내다 = pay tuition) or 납부하다.
Academic measurement noun (點數 = test score / grade / points); collocations: 점수를 받다 / 얻다 (receive a score), 점수가 높다 / 낮다, 시험 점수.
Academic regional studies noun (아시아學 = Asian studies); collocations: 아시아학 연구소 (Asian Studies Institute), 아시아학과 (Department of Asian Studies), 아시아학을 연구하다.
Academic regional studies noun (韓國學 = Korean studies); collocations: 한국학중앙연구원 (Academy of Korean Studies), 한국학과 (Korean Studies Department), 한국학 전공.
Academic school vacation noun (放學); summer is 여름방학, winter is 겨울방학. Work/employee vacation is 휴가.
Academic semester noun (學期); takes Sino-Korean numerals (1학기, 2학기). Collocates with 이번/다음 학기.
Academic specialization verb (專攻 + 하다); takes major/discipline with accusative -을/를 (경제학을 전공하다).
Academic status noun (休學 = leave of absence from school); antonym 복학(하다) (return to school); collocates with 휴학을 신청하다, 휴학계.
Academic subject noun (歷史); collocates with 배우다/공부하다. Homonym with train station building (驛舍).
Academic title; respectful title suffix is -님 (교수님). Counter is 분 (honorific) or 명.
Academic travel noun (留學 = study abroad); forms intransitive 유학하다 / 유학을 가다 (go abroad to study); collocations: 한국으로 유학 오다, 유학생 (overseas student).
Accessory and souvenir compound noun (열쇠 + 고리 = key ring / keychain); counter 개; popular souvenir item (기념품으로 열쇠고리를 사다).
Accessory loanword noun ('handbag / purse'); selectional restriction: takes verb 들다 (핸드백을 들다) or 메다; counter: 개.
Accommodation facility; collocates with 예약하다 (호텔을 예약하다) and 묵다/머물다 (호텔에 묵다).
Acoustic action verb ('to make noise / talk loudly / chatter'); ㄹ-irregular: 떠들어요 / 떠드니 / 떠듭니다; often prohibited in public spaces (교실/도서관에서 떠들지 마세요).
Acoustic signaling loanword noun ('bell'); counter: 개; collocates with 하차 벨을 누르다 (press transit stop bell), 초인종.
Action-prompting interjection ('well / now / come on / let us'); rallies attention or initiates shared action (자, 시작합시다!, 자, 여기 보세요).
Additive delimiter particle: replaces nominative (-이/가) and accusative (-을/를) particles, but stacks after oblique case particles (-에서도, -에게도).
Additive particle (-에다가 = 'on top of / in addition to'); attaches to nouns (비에다가 바람까지 불어요, 커피에다가 케이크도 먹었어요).
Administrative document noun (申請書 = written application form); collocates with 작성하다 / 쓰다 (fill out) and 내다 / 제출하다 (submit).
Adnominal modifier suffix: marks past tense on action verbs (먹은 음식) and present tense on descriptive adjectives (작은 가방, 예쁜 꽃).
Adnominal noun / determiner modifying following temporal noun (다음 주, 다음 달) or sequential noun (다음 사람).
Adnominal possessive particle ('s / of); attaches to noun; pronounced [에] in standard colloquial speech (나의 -> 내, 저의 -> 제, 너의 -> 네).
Adnominal relational particle linking nouns ('of / relating to', e.g. 한국의 역사, 평화의 상징); frequently omitted in casual spoken Korean.
Adnominal temporal modifier (from 지나다 + -ㄴ); modifies time nouns (지난 주, 지난 달). Governs past tense in predicate.
Advance ticket purchase verb (豫買); strictly collocates with tickets (표, 기차표, 비행기표, 영화표). Contrasts with 예약하다 (reservations for rooms/tables).
Adverbial form of 늦다 ('late'); antonym of 일찍. Modifies verbs (늦게 자다, 늦게 오다).
Adverbializing suffix on adjective stems ('-ly / in a manner of'); e.g. 맛있게 드세요, 예쁘게 입다, 빠르게 걷다. Also indicates purpose ('so that...').
Adversative conjunctive adverb (하지만 = but / however / yet); sentence-initial contrasting connector in everyday speech and writing: 비싸요. 하지만 좋아요.
Adversative/contrastive clause connective ('but / however'); attaches to action verbs (-는데), descriptive verbs (-(으)ㄴ데), copula (인데), past tense (-았/었는데).
Advertising agency workplace (廣告會社); takes allative -에 with 다니다 (광고 회사에 다니다).
Aerobic exercise verb (jogging + 하다 = to jog); argument frame: [Place]에서 조깅하다 (공원에서 조깅하다); collocations: 아침 조깅, 조깅화 (running shoes).
Aesthetic adjective (華麗하다 = glamorous / splendid / fancy / ornate); modifies clothes, performances, lights (화려한 옷, 화려한 도시); antonym is 수수하다/단순하다.
Aesthetic appraisal adjective (멋 + 있다 = stylish / cool / splendid); pronunciation [머싣따] or [머딛따]; applies to people, actions, scenery (멋있는 옷, 멋있는 사람).
Age adjective ('to be young/childish'); applies to age of persons/children (나이가 어리다, 어린 시절); antonym is 나이가 많다/늙다; contrast with 젊다 (youthful adult).
Age noun: pairs with Pure Korean counter 살 (or honorific 연세 with 드시다)
Age/duration adjective ('old / longstanding' for inanimate objects, buildings, friendships, traditions); cannot be used for living humans (which use 나이가 많다/늙다); antonym is 새것 / 새롭다.
Agricultural/culinary vegetable noun ('napa cabbage'); counter: 포기 (1 head of cabbage); collocates with 배추김치, 배추를 절이다.
Airline company (航空社); associated with 비행기 and flight attendants (승무원).
Airplane noun (飛行機); venue is 공항, ticket is 비행기표. Collocates with 타다 (board), 뜨다 (take off), 내리다.
Airport facility noun (空港); takes locative -에서 with 비행기를 타다 / 도착하다.
Airport shuttle bus; connects city and airport. Takes verb 타다.
Animate accompaniment verb (to bring a person or pet); takes accusative -을/를 (아이를 데려오다, 강아지를 데려오다); honorific suppletion is 모셔오다 (for elders/parents); contrast with 사물 가져오다.
Animate dative particle: -에게 (formal/written), -한테 (colloquial). Restricted to persons/animals; inanimate entities take -에; honorific takes -께.
Apparel compound noun (半 + 바지 = short trousers / shorts); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 입다 (반바지를 입다/벗다).
Apparel compound noun (運動服 = sportswear / gym clothes); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 입다 (운동복을 입다); counter: 벌.
Apparel loanword noun ('one-piece dress'); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 입다 (원피스를 입다); counter: 벌.
Apparel noun ('vest / waistcoat'); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 입다 (조끼를 입다); counter: 벌.
Apparel noun (女性服 = women's clothing / womenswear); collocates with 여성복 매장; antonym is 남성복.
Apparel noun (洋服 = Western-style formal suit); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 입다 (양복을 입다); counter: 벌 (suit).
Apparel noun (男性服 = men's apparel/clothing); collocates with 남성복 매장; antonym is 여성복.
Apparel noun (靑 + 바지 = blue jeans / denim pants); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 입다 (청바지를 입다); counter: 벌.
Apparel noun; counter is 벌 (한 벌, 두 벌). Collocates with 입다 (put on/wear), 벗다 (take off), 빨다 (launder).
Appearance adjective ('handsome / good-looking'); predominantly inflected in past adnominal 잘생긴 (잘생긴 사람) or past predicate 잘생겼어요; antonym is 못생기다.
Approximation and degree bound noun (程度 = about / approximately / degree); attaches to numerical quantities without particle: 한 시간 정도 (about an hour), 10만 원 정도; synonym 쯤 / 대략.
Approximative delimiter suffix ('about / approximately'); attaches directly to numbers, time expressions, and counters (30분쯤, 5천 원쯤).
Approximative numerical adverb (about / approximately / around); premodifies numbers and counters: 한 시간 (about an hour), 한 10분 (about 10 mins); synonym 약 (約) / 대략.
Aquatic animal noun (물 + 고기 = living fish in water / aquarium); counter 마리; collocations: 물고기를 잡다 / 기르다; contrast with 생선 (culinary fish for cooking/eating).
Archaeological and cultural noun (遺物 = historic relic / cultural artifact); counter 점; collocations: 박물관 유물, 역사적 유물을 보존하다 / 발굴하다.
Architectural noun (壁 = wall); locative destination -에 (벽에 시계를 걸다).
Architectural noun (玄關 = front entrance / foyer); collocates with 현관문, 현관에서 신발을 벗다.
Architectural spatial noun (室內 = indoors / room interior); locative 실내에서 (indoors; 실내에서 마스크를 쓰다); antonym 실외 (室外); collocations: 실내 온도, 실내화 (indoor slippers).
Aspectual adverb ('still / not yet'); strongly governs negative predicates in 'not yet' contexts (아직 안 했어요, 아직 몰라요).
Aspectual continuation adverb (繼續 = continuously / keep on / unceasingly); premodifies ongoing/repeated predicates (계속 공부하다, 계속 비가 오다); forms transitive 계속하다 (to continue).
Assistance nominal (돕다 + 음 = help / assistance); collocates with 도움을 주다/받다/청하다, 도움이 되다 (to be helpful).
Atmosphere noun (雰圍氣 = ambiance / mood / vibe); collocates with 분위기가 좋다/어둡다/화기애애하다, 분위기를 띄우다.
Atmospheric environmental noun (微細 + 먼지 = particulate matter / fine dust); collocations: 미세 먼지가 심하다 / 나쁘다 (severe fine dust), 미세 먼지 농도, 미세 먼지 마스크를 쓰다.
Atmospheric meteorological noun (fog / mist); strongly paired with verb 끼다 (안개가 끼다 = fog gathers); antonym pairing with 걷히다 (안개가 걷히다 = fog lifts); 짙은 안개.
Attendance verb (出席 + 하다 = to be present / attend); takes venue with allative -에 (수업에/모임에 출석하다); antonym is 결석하다 (缺席하다).

Audio CD loanword; flat counter is 장. Collocates with 음악을 듣다.
Auditory perception noun ('sound / noise / voice'); collocates with 소리를 듣다/내다, 소리가 크다/작다, 빗소리, 새소리.
Autumn foliage sightseeing VP (丹楓 + 구경); seasonal activity paired with 가을 and 산 (산으로 단풍 구경을 가다).
Autumn season noun; takes time particle -에 (가을에). Collocates with 시원하다, 선선하다, and 단풍.
Auxiliary attempt verb (-아/어 보다 = try doing); imperative: -아/어 보세요.
Auxiliary attempt verb construction attaching via -아/어 보다 ('try doing / give doing a try', e.g. 입어 보세요, 먹어 보세요).
Auxiliary experiential verb (-아/어 보다 = have done / experienced); past tense: -아/어 봤어요.
Auxiliary experiential verb construction attaching via -아/어 보다, typically in past tense -아/어 봤다 or with -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다 ('have experienced doing', e.g. 한국에 가 봤어요).
Auxiliary volitional construction: verb stem + -고 싶다. Restricted to 1st person in declaratives and 2nd person in interrogatives; 3rd person requires -고 싶어하다.
Avian animal noun (bird / avian fauna); counter 마리; collocations: 새가 날아가다 (bird flies away), 새가 지저귀다 (birds chirp), 새소리 (birdsong).
Aviation and postal compound noun (航空便 = airmail / flight route); instrumental 항공편으로 (by airmail; 항공편으로 보내다); antonym 배편 (surface mail).
Aviation travel document (航空券 = airline flight ticket); counter 장; collocations: 항공권을 예매하다 / 끊다 (book flight tickets), 왕복/편도 항공권.
Background context clause connective (-는데) establishing background information for the subsequent clause.
Background context connective (-는데) for action verbs in present/past tense.
Background/introductory clause connective ('and/so/while', sets context for main clause); attaches to action verbs (-는데), descriptive verbs (-(으)ㄴ데), copula (인/인데), past tense (-았/었는데).
Background/introductory sentence ending ('... and / so / you see'); Action verbs and past tense take -는데요 (가는데요, 먹었는데요); Descriptive verbs take -(으)ㄴ데요 (예쁜데요, 작은데요); nouns take 인데요.
Bakery compound noun (크림 + 빵); counter is 개. Collocates with 먹다.
Bakery loanword; whole cake counter is 개, slice counter is 조각. Collocates with 생일 and 먹다.
Banking document noun (通帳 = bankbook / passbook / bank account record); collocations: 통장을 만들다 / 개설하다 (open bank account), 통장 정리 (bankbook update).
Battery charger noun (充電器); counter is 개. Collocates with 휴대폰 and 꽂다 (plug in).
Bedding noun ('blanket / quilt / duvet'); collocates with 이불을 덮다 (cover with blanket), 이불을 펴다/개다 (spread/fold blanket); counter: 채.
Beginning of the year noun (年初); antonym is 연말 (年末); takes time particle -에 (연초에).
Beginning/start noun (始作); antonym of 끝. Forms active 시작하다 and passive 시작되다.
Beverage noun (生水 = bottled mineral/drinking water); counter: 병 (bottle); collocates with 생수를 마시다/사다.
Beverage noun (飮料 = beverage / drink; also 음료수); collocates with 음료를 마시다; counter: 잔, 병, 캔.
Beverage venue; takes locative -에서 with 커피를 마시다, 이야기하다.
Bicycle noun (自轉車); counter is 대. Collocates with 타다 (자전거를 타다).
Biological taxon noun (動物 = animal / beast); counter 마리; collocations: 동물원 (zoo), 반려동물 (companion animal/pet), 야생 동물 (wild animal).
Blending verb ('to mix / blend / combine together'); takes objects with -와/과 or -을/를 (물을 섞다, 커피와 우유를 섞다); contrast with 비비다 (rubbing together).
Board sports item; collocates strictly with 타다 (스노보드를 타다). Venue takes 스키장.
Body part noun ('ear'); collocates with 밝다/어둡다 (귀가 밝다/어둡다 = sharp/poor hearing), 귀를 기울이다 (listen attentively).
Body part noun ('face'); collocates with 씻다 (세수하다 / 얼굴을 씻다), 빨개지다 (face turns red), 얼굴이 두껍다 (brazen).
Body part noun ('foot'); collocates with 씻다 (발을 씻다), 밟다, 발이 넓다 (idiom: well-connected/wide network); footwear classifier pairing.
Body part noun ('forehead / brow'); collocates with 짚다 (이마를 짚다 = check temperature on forehead), 넓다/좁다.
Body part noun ('hand'); collocates with 씻다 (손을 씻다), 잡다 (손을 잡다), 손이 크다 (idiom: generous/big spender), 손을 흔들다.
Body part noun ('knee / lap'); collocates with 꿇다 (무릎을 꿇다 = kneel), 아프다, 다치다.
Body part noun ('mouth / lips'); collocates with 열다/다물다 (입을 열다/다물다), 입이 무겁다/가볍다 (idiom: good/bad at keeping secrets), 입맛 (appetite).
Body part noun ('nose'); collocates with 풀다 (코를 풀다 = blow nose), 막히다 (코가 막히다 = stuffy nose), 코가 높다 (high nose bridge / proud).
Body part noun ('shoulder'); collocates with 으쓱하다, 결리다 (어깨가 결리다 = stiff shoulder), 어깨동무하다.
Body part noun ('waist / lower back'); collocates with 아프다 (허리가 아프다 = back pain), 굽히다/펴다 (허리를 굽히다/펴다 = bend/straighten back).
Book publisher workplace (出版社); takes locative -에서 with 책을 만들다 or allative -에 다니다.
Border departure verb (出國하다 = depart the country / leave abroad); argument frame: [Airport/Country]에서 출국하다; antonym 입국하다 (enter country); collocations: 출국 심사 (exit immigration).
Botanical food noun (菜蔬 = vegetables / greens; synonym 야채); collocates with 신선한 채소, 채소를 먹다.
Botanical loanword noun ('tomato'); counter: 개; collocates with 토마토를 갈다/먹다.
Bound temporal noun / suffix (末 = end of a period); collocations: 월말 / 이달 말 (end of the month), 연말 / 올해 말 (end of the year), 학기 말; antonym 초 (初 = beginning).
Bouquet compound noun (꽃 + 다발); counter is 다발 or 개. Collocates with 선물하다/축하하다.
Broadcast news loanword; collocates with 보다 (TV news), 듣다 (radio), and 나오다 (be featured).
Broadcasting occupational noun (reporter / TV field correspondent); counter 명 / 분; collocations: 방송 리포터, 리포터가 취재하다.
Broadcasting station facility (放送局); takes locative -에서 with 일하다 or allative -에 다니다.
Building floor counter (層); strictly requires Sino-Korean numerals (1층 [일층], 2층 [이층], 몇 층).
Calendar noun (날 + 字 = calendar date); collocations: 날짜를 잡다 / 정하다 (set a date), 날짜가 맞다, 오늘 날짜 (today's date).
Calendar temporal noun (平日 = weekday / ordinary day); antonym 주말 (weekend) and 공휴일 (public holiday); collocations: 평일 요금, 평일에 만나다.
Calendar temporal noun (連休 = consecutive holidays / long weekend); collocations: 황금연휴 (golden holiday), 추석/설 연휴 (Chuseok/Seollal holiday period).
Campus club noun ('student club / society'); collocates with 동아리에 들다/가입하다/활동하다.
Can take destination as direct object with -을/를 (한국을 여행하다) or combine with 가다 (한국으로 여행 가다).
Cannot take time particle -에 (*내일에 is ungrammatical). Future tense concord (-(으)ㄹ 거예요).
Cannot take time particle -에 (*모레에 is ungrammatical). Future tense concord.
Cannot take time particle -에 (*어제에 is ungrammatical). Requires past tense in predicate (-았/었어요).
Cannot take time particle -에 (*오늘에 is ungrammatical). Functions directly as adverbial noun. Tense concord with present or past.

Casual intimate interrogative ending in pan말 (해라체/반말 question marker); attaches directly to verb/adjective stems (밥 먹었니?, 어디 가니?, 좋니?).
Casual shirt loanword; counter is 벌 or 장. Collocates with upper-body apparel verb 입다 (티셔츠를 입다).

Causal connective construction (nominalizer -기 + noun 때문에 = 'because / because of'); attaches to verb/adjective stems and past tense -았/었기 때문에; formal and objective reason; cannot be followed by imperative or propositive.
Causal introductory conjunctive adverb (왜냐하면 = because / the reason being); sentence-initial introducer of explanation, canonically paired with clause ending -기 때문이다.
Causal particle attached to nouns ('because / since it is [Noun]'); consonant takes 이라서 (학생이라서, 주말이라서), vowel takes 라서 (휴일이라서, 친구라서).
Causal/sequential connective. Structural constraints: cannot host past tense (-았/었-) in first clause; cannot pair with imperative (-으세요) or propositive (-(으)ㅂ시다) main clauses.
Causative cooking verb ('to boil liquid / brew / cook soup'); takes liquid/soup with -을/를 (물을 끓이다, 라면을 끓이다, 찌개를 끓이다); intransitive paired verb is 끓다 (물이 끓다).
Causative halting/erecting verb ('to pull over / stop vehicle / set up / establish'); takes vehicle or plan with -을/를 (택시를 세우다, 차를 세우다, 계획을 세우다).
Causative transitive nurturing verb (to raise / rear / cultivate / grow); accusative -을/를: 강아지/고양이를 키우다 (keep a pet), 아이를 키우다 (raise a child), 화초를 키우다 (grow plants); stem 키우- -> 키워요 / 키워서.
Causative transitive verb of 남다 (to leave behind / save / spare); takes accusative -을/를: 음식을 남기다 (leave leftovers), 메시지/메모를 남기다 (leave a message); stem 남기- -> 남겨요 / 남겨서.
Cellular phone noun (携帶電話); machinery counter is 대. Synonymous with 휴대폰/핸드폰.
Cessation verb ('to quit / stop doing'); takes job/workplace/school with accusative -을/를 (회사를 그만두다).
Children\'s Day holiday (May 5th); takes time particle -에 (어린이날에). Collocates with 놀이공원 and 선물.
Chopsticks noun; pairs with 숟가락 (spoon) -> collective 수저. Counter for pairs is 벌 or 켤레.
Chore verb; nominal form 빨래 combines with 하다 (빨래를 하다). Stem verb is 빨다 (옷을 빨다).
Christmas tree decoration loanword; collocates with 꾸미다 (decorate) and 만들다.
Cinema facility; takes locative -에서 with 영화를 보다.
City bus vehicle loanword; stop is 버스 정류장. Collocates with 타다 (board), 내리다 (alight), 갈아타다 (transfer).
Clausal connective providing background or contrast ('but / and / background context'); used on action verbs (가는데) and past tense stems (-았/었는데).
Clausal connective providing background or contrast on descriptive adjectives (좋은데, 예쁜데) and copula 이다 (학생인데); consonant stem takes -은데, vowel stem takes -ㄴ데.
Cleaning agent noun (洗劑 = laundry or dish detergent); traditional housewarming gift (symbolizing bubbling prosperity); collocates with 세탁 세제, 주방 세제.
Clothing collocation: 입다 applies to body apparel (shirt/pants), not shoes (신다) or headwear (쓰다)
Clothing noun; counter is 벌. Collocates with verb 입다 (치마를 입다) and length adjectives 길다/짧다.
Coastal geography noun (海邊 = beach / seashore / seaside); collocates with 해변을 걷다 / 해변가.
Cognate object-verb construction (춤 + 을 + 추다); collocates with music (음악에 맞춰 춤을 추다).
Cognitive memory verb (記憶 + 하다 = to remember / retain in memory); takes memory/person with -을/를 (그 사람을 기억하다, 약속을 기억하다); antonym is 잊어버리다.
Cognitive psychological noun (關心 = interest / concern / attention); argument frame: [Noun]에 관심이 있다 / 없다 / 많다 (한국 문화에 관심이 많아요), 관심을 갖다 / 끌다.
Collocates strictly with verb 하다 (축구를 하다), never with 치다. Venue takes 운동장.
Collocates with food/drink as direct object in ordering contexts (음식을 시키다). Can also function as causative suffix/verb.
Collocates with 닦다 (이를 닦다 = brush teeth). Homonym with demonstrative 이, number 2, subject marker -이, and bound noun 이 (person).
Collocates with 담그다 (to make/ferment kimchi) and 먹다. Quality adjectives: 맵다, 짜다, 맛있다.
Collocates with 치다 (골프를 치다) or 하다. Facility takes 골프장.
Collocates with 하다 (농구를 하다). Venue takes 농구장.
Collocates with 하다 (서핑을 하다). Takes locative 바다에서.
Collocates with 하다 (수영하다 / 수영을 하다). Venue takes 수영장.
Colloquial demonstrative pronoun (from 이것); case contractions: 이게 (nominative), 이건 (topic), 이걸 (accusative).
Colloquial interjection / casual informal affirmative ('uh / oh / yeah'); in pan말 functions as casual 'yes' (어, 알았어); filler when startled.
Colloquial spoken causal connective (-아/어 가지고 = 'because / so / since'); attaches to verb/adjective stems via -아/어 (배가 아파 가지고 병원에 갔어요); highly frequent in informal spoken Korean.
Colloquial spoken sequential connective (-아/어 가지고 = 'having done X, and then Y / with that done'); attaches to action verbs (돈을 찾아 가지고 올게요).
Color adjective ('blue / green / verdant' for sky, sea, grass, trees); 러-irregular inflection: 푸르러요 / 푸르러 (러-irregular subtype where -어 becomes -러: 푸르다 -> 푸르러요).
Color adjective ('crimson red / bright red'); ㅎ-irregular: 빨개요 / 빨간 (adnominal) / 빨갰어요; color noun is 빨간색; antonym is 파랗다.
Color adjective ('pure black / jet black'); ㅎ-irregular: 까매요 / 까만 (adnominal) / 까맸어요; antonym is 하얗다; color noun is 검은색 / 까만색.
Color adjective ('pure white / snow white'); ㅎ-irregular: 하얘요 / 하얀 (adnominal) / 하얬어요; color noun is 하얀색 / 흰색; antonym is 까맣다.
Color adjective ('vivid blue'); ㅎ-irregular: 파래요 / 파란 (adnominal) / 파랬어요; color noun is 파란색; antonym is 빨갛다.
Color adjective ('yellow'); ㅎ-irregular: 노래요 / 노란 (adnominal) / 노랬어요; color noun is 노란색.
Color noun (보라 + 色 = purple / violet); modifies noun directly or with possessive (보라색 옷).
Color noun (하늘 + 色 = sky blue); modifies nouns directly (하늘색 셔츠).
Color noun (흰 + 色 = white color); modifies nouns directly (흰색 모자); paired descriptive verb is 하얗다.
Color noun (灰色 = gray / ash color); modifies nouns directly (회색 바지).
Color noun (粉紅 + 色 = pink); modifies noun directly (분홍색 치마).
Combines with -하다 to form intransitive verb 산책하다, or takes accusative with 하다/가다 (산책을 하다/가다).
Combines with 무슨 for what day of the week (무슨 요일). Takes time particle -에 (토요일에).

Comitative and coordinating nominal particle: (1) conjunction ('and'): consonant noun takes 과 (책과 연필), vowel noun takes 와 (사과와 배); (2) comitative ('with'): [Person]와/과 함께 / 같이 (친구와 같이 가요); formal/written register.
Commercial facility loanword noun ('mart / supermarket'); collocates with 마트에 가다, 장을 보다; locative -에서.
Commercial facility noun (美容室 = hair salon / beauty salon); collocates with 미용실에 가다, 머리를 자르다.
Commercial food noun (食料品 = groceries / foodstuffs); collocates with 식료품점, 식료품 코너.
Commercial loanword verb (sale + 하다 = to have a sale / discount); takes merchandise with -을/를 (옷을 세일하다) or intransitive (지금 세일해요).
Commercial noun (割引 = discount / reduction); collocates with 할인을 받다/하다, 할인점, 할인 행사.
Commercial noun (商品 = merchandise / product / prize); collocates with 상품을 판매하다, 상품권 (gift card).
Commercial service compound (이삿짐 + 센터 = moving company / movers); collocates with 이삿짐센터를 부르다/예약하다.
Commercial transaction verb ('to sell'); ㄹ-irregular: 팔아요 / 파니 / 팝니다; takes object with -을/를 and buyer with -에게; antonym is 사다.
Commodity transaction noun (交換 = exchange / replacement / swap); collocates with 교환하다, 환불 (refund: 교환 및 환불), 언어 교환 (language exchange).
Communication / document noun (題目 = title / heading / subject line); collocations: 책/영화/노래 제목 (title of book/movie/song), 제목을 붙이다 / 정하다 (give/decide a title), 이메일 제목 (email subject).
Communication noun (電話 = telephone / phone call); collocations: 전화를 걸다 / 하다 (make a phone call), 전화를 받다 (answer the phone), 전화번호 (phone number), 전화가 오다 (phone is ringing); forms 전화하다.

Communication verb (이야기하다 = to talk / chat / converse / tell a story); contracted spoken form 얘기하다; frames: (1) intransitive conversation [Partner]와/과 이야기하다 (친구와 이야기하다); (2) transitive topic [Topic]에 대해 이야기하다 (한국에 대해 이야기하다); stem 이야기하- -> 이야기해요 / 이야기해서 / 이야기했습니다.
Commute compound noun (出退勤 = commuting to and from work); collocates with 출퇴근 시간 (rush hour), 출퇴근하다.
Comparative adjective ('similar / alike / resemblance'); takes partner with -와/과 or -(으)랑 (친구와 비슷하다); antonym is 다르다 (different).
Comparative adverb ('more'); pairs with standard of comparison marker -보다 (이것보다 더 크다).
Comparative evaluation adjective (to be better / superior / preferable); comparative frame: [Noun]보다 낫다 (집에 있는 것이 낫다); s-irregular paradigm (나아요 / 나아서 / 나으면; 낫고 / 낫습니다).
Comparative evaluation phrase (결과가 + 다르다 = outcome is different / yields different result); 르-irregular on 다르다: 결과가 달라요 / 달라서.
Comparative particle attached to the standard of comparison (Noun + 보다); marks the baseline in comparative statements (기차보다 비행기가 더 빠릅니다).
Competitive event noun (大會 = contest / competition / tournament); collocates with 대회에 나가다/참가하다, 상을 타다; e.g. 말하기 대회, 요리 대회.
Complexity adjective (單純하다 = simple / plain / uncomplicated); modifies structure, design, thoughts; antonym is 복잡하다.
Compound administrative noun (連絡處 = contact details / contact number); collocates with 연락처를 남기다 / 묻다 / 가르쳐 주다 / 교환하다.
Compound administrative noun (郵便番號 = postal code / ZIP code); collocates with 우편번호를 적다 / 쓰다 / 검색하다 (search/write postal code).
Compound benefactive assistance verb (돕다 + 주다); takes accusative person (친구를 도와주다) or dative (도와주세요); honorific equivalent is 도와드리다.
Compound benefactive assistance verb (듣다 + 주다 = to listen to and grant); collocates with 부탁/소원을 들어주다 (grant a favor/wish).
Compound clothing action verb (갈다 + 입다 = to change clothes); takes clothing with -을/를 (옷을 갈아입다, 잠옷으로 갈아입다).
Compound cognitive verb (알다 + 보다 = to look into / inquire / recognize); takes object with -을/를 (정보를 알아보다, 길을 알아보다, 사람을 알아보다).
Compound financial noun (計座番號 = bank account number); collocates with 계좌 번호를 알려주다 (provide account number), 계좌 번호를 입력하다 (enter account number).
Compound inquiry verb (묻다 + 보다); takes person with -에게/한테 and question with -을/를 (길을 물어보다). Humble form is 여쭈어보다.
Compound institutional noun (現金自動引出機 = automated teller machine / ATM); often abbreviated as ATM or 현금인출기; collocates with 현금 자동 인출기에서 돈을 뽑다 / 찾다.
Compound institutional noun (豫約席 = reserved seat / reserved table); collocates with 예약석 팻말 (reserved sign), 여기는 예약석입니다.
Compound kinship noun (남 + 동생); younger sibling, takes plain non-honorific verb concord.
Compound kinship noun (여 + 동생); younger sibling, takes plain non-honorific verb concord.
Compound loanword facility noun (service center / customer repair shop); locative -에 가다 / -에서 수리하다 (휴대폰을 고치러 서비스 센터에 가다).
Compound loss verb (잃다 + 버리다 = to lose an object / misplaced); takes object with -을/를 (지갑을 잃어버리다, 길을 잃어버리다); contrast with 잊어버리다 (forget memory/fact).
Compound memory loss verb (잊다 + 버리다 = to forget completely); takes information, fact, or promise with -을/를 (약속을 잊어버리다, 단어를 잊어버리다); contrast with 잃어버리다 (physically lose an object).
Compound modality construction (-아/어야 + -겠- + -다 = 'definitely have to / will have to / ought to'); conveys speaker's firm immediate decision/obligation (빨리 가야겠다, 청소해야겠다).
Compound monthly frequency adverb (每 + 달 = every month / monthly); synonyms 매월 / 달마다; collocations: 매달 돈을 보내다, 매달 1일 (1st of every month).
Compound motion verb (다니다 + 오다 = to go and return / make a round trip); takes destination with allative -에 (한국에/고향에 다녀오다).
Compound noun (구경 + 거리 = sight to see / attraction / spectacle); collocates with 많다 (구경거리가 많다).
Compound noun (기차 + 표); counter is 장. Collocates with 예매하다/사다.
Compound noun (다음 + 일) denoting the next work, task, or matter.
Compound noun (비행기 + 표); counter is 장. Collocates with 예매하다/사다.
Compound noun (약속 + 시간); collocates with 정하다 (set time), 늦다 (be late to time).
Compound noun (약속 + 장소); collocates with 정하다 (set meeting place) and directional -에 가다.
Compound noun (영화 + 표); counter is 장. Collocates with 예매하다/사다.
Compound noun (이사 + ㅅ + 짐 = moving luggage / household belongings); collocates with 이삿짐을 싸다/풀다/나르다.
Compound noun (時間表 = timetable / schedule); common collocations: 시간표를 짜다 (make a class schedule), 시간표를 보다 / 확인하다.
Compound noun (秘密番號 = secret number / PIN / password); collocates with 비밀번호를 누르다 / 입력하다 (enter PIN/password), 비밀번호를 잊어버리다 (forget password).
Compound placement verb (올리다 + 놓다 = place onto / put on top); argument frame: [Noun:place]에 [Noun:object]을/를 올려놓다 (저울 위에 소포를 올려놓다); conjugates 올려놓아요 / 올려놓아서.
Compound predicate (시간 + 이 + 없다). Subject particle -이 can be omitted (시간 없다). Antonym is 시간이 있다.
Compound sports equipment noun (籠球 + 공 = basketball); counter 개; collocates with 농구공을 던지다 / 패스하다 / 튀기다.
Compound temporal noun (방학 + 中); indicates interval of school vacation. Takes time particle -에 (방학 중에).
Compound temporal noun (지난 + 달); takes time particle -에 (지난달에). Requires past tense.
Compound temporal noun (지난 + 주); takes time particle -에 (지난주에). Requires past tense.
Compound temporal noun (지난 + 해); takes time particle -에 (지난해에). Requires past tense.
Compound temporal noun; takes time particle -에 (다음 달에). Future tense concord.
Compound temporal noun; takes time particle -에 (다음 주에). Future tense concord.
Compound transit verb ('to transfer vehicles/lines'); takes destination line with instrumental -로 (2호선으로 갈아타다) and transfer station with -에서.

Compromise / second-best option particle ('even if it is just / at least / any'); consonant takes 이라도 (물이라도, 밥이라도), vowel takes 라도 (커피라도); also used with question words for indefinite free choice (누구라도 = anyone, 언제라도 = anytime).

Concessive clausal connective (-아/어도 = 'even if / even though / although'); vowel harmony applies (-아도 after ㅏ/ㅗ, -어도 after other vowels, -해도 for 하다 verbs); frequently paired with adverb 아무리 (아무리 비싸도 사요).
Concessive degree adverb (no matter how much / however); strongly pairs with concessive ending -아/어도 (아무리 바빠도 식사는 하세요, 아무리 어려워도 포기하지 말자).
Conditional conjunctive adverb (그러면, contracted 그럼 = then / in that case / if so); sentence-initial connector: 그러면 내일 만나요 (then let's meet tomorrow).
Conditional/temporal connective suffix: vowel/ㄹ stem takes -면, consonant stem takes -으면. Connects conditional protasis to apodosis.
Confectionery loanword; counters are 개 (piece) and 상자 (box). Quality adjective 달다 (sweet).
Connective suffix attaching to verb/adjective stems to coordinate clauses or indicate sequential actions without tense marking on the first clause.
Consumer goods compound noun (生活用品 = household daily necessities/supplies); collocates with 생활용품 매장/코너.
Contact action verb ('to place against / touch / tag'); takes item with -을/를 and surface with -에 (단말기에 카드를 대다, 이마에 손을 대다).
Container / packaging noun (箱子 = box / crate / carton); counter 개 or 상자 (e.g. 사과 한 상자); collocates with 상자에 넣다 / 담다, 종이 상자 (cardboard box).
Container / stationery noun (封套 = envelope / paper bag / plastic bag); collocations: 편지 봉투 (letter envelope), 쓰레기 봉투 (trash bag), 봉투에 넣다 (put into an envelope).
Container compound noun (쓰레기 + 통 = trash can / wastebasket); collocates with 쓰레기통에 넣다/버리다.
Continuous temporal duration noun and adverb (終日 = all day long / the whole day); frequently reinforced as 하루 종일; collocations: 종일 비가 오다, 종일 집에 있다.
Contraction of 무엇 + accusative marker -을 (무엇을 -> 뭘). Functions as interrogative direct object.
Contraction of 무엇. Functions as predicate with copula (이게 뭐예요?) or colloquial direct object (뭐 해요?).
Contraction of 조금. Functions as degree adverb ('a little') and as an essential pragmatic softener in polite requests (좀 도와주세요).
Contrasting / mildly disagreeing / expectant sentence ending ('but / actually / however'); softens refusal or expresses surprise (지금 좀 바쁜데요, 저는 괜찮은데요).
Contrastive connective suffix ('but / although'); attaches directly to verb/adjective stems and can host past tense marker -았/었- in the first clause.
Contrastive/adversative clause connective (-는데) indicating contrast, opposition, or concession ('but / however').
Contrastive/adversative connective (-는데) for clauses showing opposition or concession ('but / however').
Conversational hesitation marker ('well / let me see / I\'m not sure'); expresses polite uncertainty or gentle disagreement.

Conversational intention/preference ending: -(으)ㄹ래요? ('would you like to ...? / shall we ...?'); consonant takes -을래요?, vowel/ㄹ takes -ㄹ래요? (커피 마실래요?, 어디 갈래요?). In statements, expresses speaker's casual will (저는 커피 마실래요).
Conversational response marker ('Is that so? / That\'s right'); intonation distinguishes confirmation statement vs question.
Cooking verb ('to boil solid food in water'); takes food with -을/를 (달걀을 삶다, 감자를 삶다, 고기를 삶다); contrast with 끓이다 (boiling liquids/soups).
Cooking verb ('to deep-fry / splatter'); takes food with -을/를 (치킨을 튀기다, 기름에 튀기다); also splash liquid (물을 튀기다).
Cooking verb ('to grill / roast / bake'); ㅂ-irregular: 구워요 / 구워서; takes object with -을/를 (고기를 굽다, 빵을 굽다, 생선을 굽다); homophone: curved/bent (허리가 굽다).
Cooking verb ('to slice / chop with knife'); takes food with -을/를 (고기를 썰다, 파를 송송 썰다); ㄹ-irregular stem.
Cooking verb ('to stir-fry / roast'); takes food with -을/를 (밥을 볶다 -> 볶음밥, 고기를 볶다); figurative 'to pester' (달달 볶다).
Cooking verb (양념 + 하다 = to season / marinate); takes meat/vegetable with -을/를 (고기를 양념하다).
Cookware loanword noun ('frying pan'); counter: 개; collocates with 프라이팬에 기름을 두르다.
Cookware noun ('pot / saucepan'); counter: 개; collocates with 냄비에 물을 붓다.
Corporate occupational title (team + 長 = team leader / section manager); addressed honorifically as 팀장님; counter 분 / 명.
Corporate rank noun (部長 = department manager / director); addressed politely as 부장님; workplace hierarchy position.
Cosmetic skincare loanword (sun cream = sunscreen / sunblock); strongly paired with verb 바르다 (얼굴에 선크림을 바르다 = apply sunscreen); synonym 자외선 차단제.
Cosmetics noun (化粧品); collocates with application verb 바르다 (화장품을 바르다) and 사다.
Counter for animals, birds, fish, insects; strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세, 네... 마리).
Counter for bottled drinks (물, 맥주, 콜라); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세... 병).
Counter for bound volumes/books (책, 잡지, 공책); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세, 네... 권).
Counter for cups/glasses of beverage (커피, 차, 술); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세... 잔).
Counter for flat sheets of paper, tickets, photos (종이, 표, 사진); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세... 장).
Counter for flat/board surfaces, pizzas (피자 한 판), egg crates (계란 한 판); requires Pure Korean attributive numerals.
Counter for flowers (장미 한 송이), grapes, or mushrooms; strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals.
Counter for items/suits of clothing (옷, 코트, 바지); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세... 벌).
Counter for lines, strings, and specifically rolls of kimbap (김밥 한 줄); requires Pure Korean attributive numerals.
Counter for long slender tools, pens, pencils, knives (연필 한 자루); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals.
Counter for pairs of footwear/gloves (구두, 운동화, 양말, 장갑); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세... 켤레).
Counters: 병 (bottle), 잔 (glass), 캔 (can). Pairs with drinking verb 마시다.
Courier service noun (宅配 = door-to-door delivery / package courier); collocations: 택배를 보내다 / 받다 / 시키다, 택배 기사(님) (courier delivery driver).
Cue sports noun (撞球 = billiards / pool); paired with verb 치다 (당구를 치다 = play billiards); locative 당구장 (billiard hall / pool hall).
Cuisine / dish noun; forms transitive/intransitive verb with -하다 (요리하다 = to cook). Counter for types of dish is 가지.
Culinary acid seasoning noun (食醋 = vinegar); collocates with 치다/넣다, 시다 (sour).
Culinary allium noun ('green onion / scallion'); counter: 뿌리, 단; collocates with 파를 송송 썰다, 찌개에 넣다.
Culinary compound noun (藥念/양념 = seasoning / sauce / marinade); collocates with 양념치킨, 양념을 만들다.
Culinary condiment noun (고추 + 醬 = Korean red chili paste); collocates with 넣다, 비비다 (고추장에 비비다).
Culinary distinction: 생선 is fish for food/cooking; 물고기 is living swimming fish
Culinary fungus noun ('mushroom'); counter: 개, 송이; collocates with 버섯을 볶다.
Culinary griddling verb taking accusative -을/를 for shallow-fried batters (전/부침개/달걀을 부치다); conjugates 부쳐요 / 부쳐서 / 부칩니다.
Culinary guide noun (料理法 = recipe / culinary procedure); collocates with 요리법을 배우다/따라 하다.
Culinary loanword noun ('ham'); collocates with 햄을 굽다/볶다/썰다.
Culinary loanword noun ('salad'); collocates with 샐러드를 만들다/먹다; 드레싱.
Culinary loanword noun ('sauce / dressing'); collocates with 소스에 찍어 먹다, 소스를 붓다.
Culinary loanword noun ('shabu-shabu / hot pot'); collocates with 고기와 채소를 데쳐 먹다.
Culinary loanword noun (barbecue / BBQ); collocations: 바비큐를 하다 / 굽다 / 먹다, 바비큐 파티 (BBQ party).
Culinary meat noun ('meat / flesh'); counter: 근 (600g) or 인분; collocates with 고기를 굽다/볶다/삶다.
Culinary meat noun (닭 + 고기 = chicken meat); collocates with 닭고기를 삶다/튀기다.
Culinary meat noun (돼지 + 고기 = pork); collocates with 삼겹살, 제육볶음; counter: 근, 인분.
Culinary meat noun (소 + 고기 = beef; also 쇠고기); collocates with 굽다 (소고기를 굽다), 볶다.
Culinary noun (海産物 = seafood / marine products); collocates with 싱싱하다, 신선하다, 먹다.
Culinary product compound (冷凍食品 = frozen food); collocates with 냉동실에 보관하다, 전자레인지에 데우다.
Culinary root vegetable noun ('potato'); counter: 개; collocates with 감자를 삶다/볶다/튀기다 (감자튀김).
Culinary root vegetable noun (唐根 = carrot); counter: 개; also colloquial slang for 'of course' (당근이지).
Culinary seasoning noun ('salt'); collocates with 치다/뿌리다 (소금을 치다/뿌리다), 짜다.
Culinary spice noun (胡椒 = black pepper); collocates with 후추를 뿌리다/치다.
Culinary sweetener noun (雪糖 = white sugar); collocates with 넣다, 치다, 달다.
Culinary traditional dish noun (雪濃湯 = ox bone soup); collocates with 깍두기, 밥을 말아 먹다; counter: 그릇.
Culinary vegetable noun (洋파 = onion); counter: 개; collocates with 까다 (peel), 썰다, 볶다.
Culinary/figurative verb ('to mince finely / solidify / strengthen'); takes food or resolve with -을/를 (마늘을 다지다 = mince garlic, 결심을 다지다 = harden resolve).
Culinary/physical verb ('to mix together / rub'); takes object with -을/를 (밥을 비비다 -> 비빔밥, 눈을 비비다 = rub eyes).
Cultural enthusiast noun (fan / admirer / supporter); counter 명; collocations: 팬클럽 (fan club), 팬미팅 (fan meet), 열성 팬 (devoted fan).
Cultural facility noun (찜질 + 방 = Korean 24hr sauna bathhouse); locative -에서 (찜질방에서 자다/쉬다).
Cultural holiday noun (名節 = traditional Korean national holiday, e.g. 설날, 추석); collocates with 명절을 보내다, 명절 음식.
Cultural social event noun (집 + 들이 = housewarming party); collocates with 집들이를 하다, 집들이에 초대하다; traditional gifts are 세제 and 휴지.
Cumulative additive connective clause ('in addition to / on top of that'); Action verbs take -는 데다가 (일이 많은 데다가 야근까지 해요); Descriptive verbs take -(으)ㄴ 데다가 (음식이 맛있는 데다가 값도 싸요); nouns take 인 데다가.
Currency exchange VP ('to exchange money / currency'); synonym of 환전하다. Venue takes 은행 or 공항.
Currency noun (銅錢 = metallic coin); counter 개; antonym 지폐 (paper banknote); collocations: 동전을 넣다 (insert coin in machine/slot), 잔돈 (small change).
Dative argument: pairs with person + 에게/한테 (친구에게 전화하다)
Day off / holiday noun (休日); takes time particle -에 (휴일에 쉬다). Synonymous with 쉬는 날.
Decor noun (香 + 촛 = scented candle); collocates with 향초를 켜다/피우다 (light a scented candle).
Degree adverb (幾乎 = almost / nearly); modifies verbs, adjectives, or nouns (거의 다 끝났다, 거의 매일, 거의 1시간).
Degree adverb (特別히 = especially / particularly); modifies verbs or adjectives (특별히 잘하다, 특별히 좋아하다).
Degree adverb: precedes descriptive verb or adjective

Degree and proficiency adverb (잘 = well / skillfully / frequently / often); modifies verbs: (1) proficiency (한국어를 잘하다 / 말을 잘하다), (2) thoroughness (잘 들으세요 = listen carefully), (3) frequency (잘 가다 = go often); antonym 못 / 서투르게.
Degree intensifier adverb ('very / exceedingly / immensely'); modifies descriptive and psychological verbs (무척 반갑다, 무척 바쁘다).
Demonstrative adjective ('to be so / like that'); ㅎ-irregular: 그래요, 그렇지요, 그런 (adnominal); collocates with 그렇지만, 그래도.
Demonstrative manner and degree adverb (그렇다 + -게 = like that / in that manner / that much); collocations: 그렇게 하면 안 돼요, 그렇게 어렵지 않아요 (not that difficult).

Demonstrative spatial pronoun (그 + 곳 = that place / there); refers to a place previously mentioned in discourse or distant from speaker but near listener; collocations: 그곳에 가다 / 그곳에서 살다, 그곳의 날씨; contrast with 이곳 (here / this place) and 저곳 (over there).
Dental hygiene noun (齒 + 솔 = toothbrush); counter: 개; collocates with 칫솔로 이를 닦다.
Dental toiletry noun (齒藥 = toothpaste); counter: 개; collocates with 칫솔에 치약을 짜다 (squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush).
Department store (百貨店); takes locative -에서 with 쇼핑하다 / 옷을 사다.
Departure motion verb ('to leave / set off'); takes destination with -로 (여행을 떠나다) or origin with accusative -을/를 (고향을 떠나다).
Descriptive affective adjective (支離하다 = to be boring / tedious / dull); subject takes -이/가 (영화/수업/시간이 지루하다 = movie/class/time is boring); stem 지루하- -> 지루해요 / 지루해서; antonym 재미있다.

Descriptive comparative adjective (같다 = to be the same / identical / like); (1) comparison: [Noun]와/과 같다 (생각이 나와 같다 = thoughts are the same as mine); (2) speculative auxiliary: -은/는/을 것 같다 (seems like / looks like); stem 같- -> 같아요 / 같아서 / 같습니다.
Descriptive degree adjective (甚하다 = to be severe / intense / extreme / excessive); stem 심하- -> 심해요 / 심해서; adverbial 심하게 (심하게 아프다); collocations: 기침이 심하다, 장난이 심하다.
Descriptive dimensional adjective (to be high / tall / lofty); regular stem (높아요 / 높아서 / 높고); collocates with 산/건물/하늘/온도/점수가 높다; antonym 낮다.
Descriptive dimensional adjective (to be low); regular stem (낮아요 / 낮아서 / 낮고); collocates with 키/높이/온도/점수가 낮다; antonym 높다.
Descriptive evaluation adjective (重要하다 = to be important / crucial / significant); stem 중요하- -> 중요해요 / 중요해서; collocations: 중요한 일 / 약속 / 시험.
Descriptive psychological evaluation adjective (神奇하다 = to be fascinating / marvelous / novel / wondrous); stem 신기하- -> 신기해요 / 신기해서; collocations: 정말 신기하다, 신기한 마술.
Descriptive state adjective (to be empty / vacant); subject takes -이/가 (자리가 비다, 방이 비어 있다); stem 비- -> 비어요 / 비어서; attributive 빈 (빈자리, 빈방); antonym 가득하다 / 차다.
Descriptive strength and intensity adjective (强하다 = to be strong / powerful / intense); stem 강하- -> 강해요 / 강해서; collocations: 바람/햇빛이 강하다, 힘이 강하다; antonym 약하다.
Desiderative/subjunctive construction (-았/었으면 + 좋겠다 = 'I wish / I hope that ...'); expresses speaker's wish contrary to or anticipatory of reality (비가 안 왔으면 좋겠다, 합격했으면 좋겠다).
Digital media noun (動映像 = moving picture / video clip); collocations: 동영상을 찍다 / 촬영하다 (shoot video), 동영상을 보다 / 올리다 (watch/upload video).
Dining facility noun (粉食 + 집 = casual Korean snack eatery serving tteokbokki, kimbap, ramyeon); locative -에서.
Dining facility; takes locative -에서 with eating verbs (식당에서 밥을 먹다).
Dining loanword noun (menu / dish selection); collocations: 메뉴를 고르다 / 보다, 메뉴판 (printed menu), 추천 메뉴 (recommended menu item).
Directional allative particle ('toward / in the direction of'); consonant stems take -으로 (오른쪽으로), vowel and ㄹ stems take -로 (어디로, 서울로); contrast with -에 (static destination).
Directional motion verb (左廻轉 + 하다 = to make a left turn); takes location with -에서 (사거리에서 좌회전하세요); antonym is 우회전하다.
Directional transit noun (右廻轉 = right turn); collocates with 우회전하다, 우회전 차선; antonym is 좌회전.
Directional transit noun (左廻轉 = left turn); collocates with 좌회전하다, 좌회전 신호; antonym is 우회전.
Directional/manner adverb ('straight / upright'); navigation command: 똑바로 가세요 (Go straight).

Discontinuous retrospective adnominal ending (-았/었던 = 'which had been / which used to be'); marks past completed state or habit no longer continuing in the present (살았던 곳, 작았던 옷, 친했던 사람); vowel harmony applies (-았던 after ㅏ/ㅗ, -었던 after others).
Discourse / sequential adverb (于先 = first of all / above all / beforehand); marks immediate prior step in instructions (우선 이것부터 하세요; 우선 손을 씻고 먹자).
Discourse concessive conjunction/adverb (그래도 = even so / nevertheless / still / nonetheless); sentence-initial: 비가 와요. 그래도 갈 거예요 (It is raining. Still, I will go).
Discourse manner adverb (just / simply / as it is / for no special reason); collocations: 그냥 그래요 (just so-so / so so), 그냥 가세요 (just go), 있는 그대로.
Discourse transition: connects preceding context to follow-up suggestion/question

Discourse transition/adversative adverb (그런데 = by the way / however / but); sentence-initial: (1) changes conversation topic ('by the way / anyway'), (2) expresses unexpected contrast ('however / but'); contracted spoken form 근데.
Dishware noun (접시 = plate / dish / flat platter); counter: 개 or 접시 (한 접시); collocates with 접시에 담다.
Disjunctive choice particle attached to nouns ('or / or something / something like'); consonant takes 이나 (주말에 영화나 볼까요?), vowel takes 나 (차나 마셔요).
Disjunctive choice particle on nouns ('or / or something'); consonant takes 이나, vowel takes 나 (차나 마실까요?); duplicate curriculum entry corresponding to ID 1333.
Disjunctive clausal connective ('or / whether X or Y'); attaches directly to verb/adjective stems without batchim distinction (먹거나, 마시거나; 크거나 작거나); parallel repetition A거나 B거나.
Disposal verb ('to throw away / discard'); takes waste with -을/를 (쓰레기를 버리다); auxiliary -아/어 버리다 indicates completing an action with relief or regret.
Distal demonstrative adjective ('to be like that over there'); ㅎ-irregular: 저래요 / 저런 (adnominal); adverbial is 저렇게 ('like that').

Distal demonstrative determiner (저 = that over there); prenominal modifier preceding noun: 저 건물 (that building over there), 저 사람 (that person over there); refers to entities physically distant from both speaker and listener.
Distal directional noun ('that way over there'); navigational formula: 저쪽으로 가세요.
Distal locative pronoun ('over there'); also polite conversational call-out filler to strangers or servers ('Excuse me!' = 저기요!).
Distribution verb ('to sprinkle / scatter / spray'); takes seasoning/liquid with -을/를 and target with -에 (소금을 뿌리다, 물을 뿌리다, 향수를 뿌리다).
Ditransitive verb: takes dative recipient with -에게/한테 and gift theme with -을/를 (친구에게 꽃을 선물하다).
Ditransitive: takes indirect object with dative -에게/한테 and direct object with -을/를. Humble/honorific counterpart is 드리다. Functions as benefactive auxiliary -어/아 주다.
Diurnal temporal noun (daytime / daylight hours); locative 낮에 (in the daytime); antonym 밤 (night); collocations: 낮잠을 자다 (take an afternoon nap), 낮과 밤.
Document compound noun (計劃表 = written schedule / timetable / plan chart); collocations: 계획표를 짜다 / 세우다 (make a schedule), 일일 계획표 (daily plan).
Doll/toy noun (人形); counter is 개. Collocates with 선물하다 and 가지고 놀다.
Domestic chore compound noun (집안 + 일 = housework / household chores); collocations: 집안일을 하다 (do chores), 집안일을 돕다 / 분담하다 (share housework).
Domestic chore transitive verb (to fold); accusative -을/를 for laundry, apparel, or bedding (빨래/옷/이불을 개다); stem 개- -> 개요 / 개어서.
Domestic chore verb (다림질하다 = to iron clothes); accusative -을/를 (셔츠/옷을 다림질하다); related instrument 다리미 (electric iron); stem 다림질하- -> 다림질해요 / 다림질해서.
Double batchim ㄺ adjective: pronounced [막따] before consonants, [말꼬] before ㄱ, and [말가요] before vowels. Weather and water clarity.
Downward motion verb ('to go down'); antonym of 올라가다. Takes path with -로 (계단으로 내려가다).
Dress shirt loanword; counter is 벌. Collocates with upper-body apparel verb 입다 (와이셔츠를 입다).
Dress shoes; pair counter is 켤레 (한 켤레, 두 켤레). Strictly takes footwear verb 신다 (구두를 신다).
Drinkware noun (차 + ㅅ + 잔 = teacup); counter: 개 or 잔; collocates with 찻잔에 차를 따르다.
Dual noun: functions both as time point (evening) and meal (dinner: 저녁을 먹다)
Dual noun: functions both as time point (morning) and meal (breakfast: 아침을 먹다)
Dual noun: functions both as time point (noon) and meal (lunch: 점심을 먹다)
Dual quantifier noun (둘 + 도/다 = both / both of them); collocates with 둘 다 좋다, 둘 다 사다.
Duration counter for hours (한 시간, 두 시간); strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals. Contrasts with o\'clock time marker 시.
Duration delimiter particle attaching to elapsed time expressions ('after [duration] / for the first time in [duration]', e.g. 3년 만에, 며칠 만에 만나다).
Duty-free retail facility (免稅店); collocates with 공항 and 쇼핑하다.
Early childhood educational facility (幼稚園 = kindergarten / preschool); collocations: 유치원에 다니다, 유치원 선생님 (kindergarten teacher), 유치원생.
Educational facility (museum); takes locative -에서 with 구경하다/보다.
Educational facility noun (學院 = private cram school / private academy / hagwon); collocations: 학원에 다니다 (attend a hagwon), 영어/피아노/태권도 학원.
Educational institution noun (學校 = school); collocations: 학교에 가다 / 다니다 (go/attend school), 학교생활 (school life), 초/중/고등학교 (elementary/middle/high school), 대학교 (university); locative -에 / -에서.

Elapsed interval bound particle (만 = after a lapse of / after [duration]); attached to time duration followed by -에: 3년 만에 (after 3 years), 얼마 만이에요? (how long has it been!); requires prior duration expression.
Elapsed time construction: verb stem + -(으)ㄴ 지 + [Time interval] + 되다/지나다/넘다 ('it has been [time] since doing X'); spacing required before bound noun 지.
Electronic device noun (端末機 = terminal / electronic card reader device); collocates with 단말기에 카드를 대다.
Electronic goods compound (家電製品 = home electric appliances, e.g. 냉장고, 세탁기, TV); collocates with 가전제품 매장.
Email loanword; message counter is 통. Collocates with 보내다 (send) and 받다 (receive).
Emotion adjective ('envious / jealous of someone's fortune'); ㅂ-irregular: 부러워요 / 부러워서; takes target with -이/가 (친구가 부럽다); 3rd person uses 부러워하다.
Emotion adjective ('glad / joyful'); ㅡ-irregular: 기뻐요 / 기뻐서; for 3rd person or action verb, use 기뻐하다.
Emotion adjective ('lonely / solitary'); ㅂ-irregular: 외로워요 / 외로워서; 3rd person uses 외로워하다.

Emotion adjective ('regretful / disappointed / sad to part'); ㅂ-irregular: 섭섭해요 / 섭섭해서; expresses sentimental disappointment at parting or unmet consideration; contrast with 실망하다 (cold disappointment).
Emotion adjective ('shy / embarrassed / ashamed'); ㅂ-irregular: 부끄러워요 / 부끄러워서; 3rd person / action uses 부끄러워하다.
Emotion adjective ('to miss / long for'); ㅂ-irregular: 그리워요 / 그리워서; takes subject/theme with -이/가 (고향이 그립다, 친구가 그립다); when 1st person expresses longing in transitive action, uses 그리워하다 (고향을 그리워하다).
Emphatic double negative obligation construction ('must / cannot not do / have to'); attaches to verb stem + -지 않으면 안 되다 (공부하지 않으면 안 돼요 = one must study); stronger rhetorical necessity than -아/어야 하다.
Emphatic high-degree construction: 얼마나 + verb-는지 / adjective-(으)ㄴ지 + 모르다 ('you have no idea how ... / so very ...', e.g. 얼마나 기쁜지 몰라요).
Emphatic truth/degree adverb ('really / truly'); synonymous with 진짜. Modifies verbs, adjectives, or functions as interjection.
Endpoint/conclusion noun; antonym of 시작. Collocates with copula (이제 끝이에요) or 끝이 나다.
Enforce 1st-person humble possessive concord with polite/formal register
Enforce 1st-person humble pronoun concord with polite/formal register
Enforce post-nominal attachment strictly to personal Name tokens
Enforce pre-nominal determiner collocation [어느 + Noun]
Enforce spatial relational structure: [Noun (+ 의)] + position + 에/에서
Enforce subject particle contraction 누구 + 가 -> 누가
Entertainment venue (theater/cinema); takes locative -에서 with 영화/연극을 보다.
Entertainment venue; takes locative -에서 with 놀다 or directional -에 가다.
Environmental hygiene noun (換氣 = ventilation / airing out); forms 환기하다 / 환기시키다; collocations: 창문을 열어 환기하다 (open windows to ventilate), 실내 환기.
Epistemic conjecture construction: verb/adjective stem + -(으)ㄹ 거예요 ('probably / I think it will ...'); 2nd/3rd person subject or weather/state (내일 비가 올 거예요, 맛있을 거예요).
Epistemic conjecture pre-final suffix ('looks like / must be'); attaches directly to descriptive or action verb stem (맛있겠다, 힘들겠다, 비가 오겠다); evaluates sensory/situational evidence.
Epistemic question ending asking listener's opinion/guess ('do you think ...?'); descriptive or 3rd person action verbs (내일 날씨가 좋을까요?, 그 영화가 재미있을까요?).

Equative degree particle and bound noun ('as much as / to the extent of / equivalent to'); attaches directly to nouns without batchim distinction (너만큼, 형만큼); attaches to verb adnominals -(으)ㄹ 만큼 (먹을 만큼 담으세요).
Equipment compound noun (sports + 用品 = sporting goods / sports equipment); collocates with 스포츠용품 매장.
Event noun; takes locative -에서 (콘서트에서 노래를 듣다) or goal directional -에 (콘서트에 가다).
Exclamatory interjection expressing admiration or surprise ('wow!'). Distinct from comitative particle -와.

Exclamatory realization sentence ender ('I see that... / Oh, so...'); expresses speaker's immediate perception or discovery of a new fact; Action verbs take -는군요 (벌써 가는군요, 한국어를 잘하시는군요); Descriptive verbs take -군요 (날씨가 춥군요, 방이 넓군요); Nouns take -(이)군요 (선생님이군요 / 의사군요); past tense takes -았/었군요; informal counterpart is -는구나 / -구나.

Exclusive delimiter particle ('only / just / solely'); attaches directly to nouns without batchim distinction (사과만, 저만); can replace subject/object particles or attach after oblique particles (도서관에서만, 친구에게만); contrast with 밖에 (+ negative).
Exit noun (出口); subway exits use Sino-Korean number + 번 (3번 출구). Collocates with 나가다 (1번 출구로 나가다).
Expansion/improvement verb ('to increase / multiply / improve'); ㄹ-irregular: 늘어요 / 느니 / 늡니다; takes subject with -이/가 (한국어 실력이 늘다, 인구가 늘다); antonym is 줄다.
Experiential aspect construction: verb stem + -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다/없다 ('have/have not ever done X'); vowel/ㄹ stem takes -ㄴ 적이, consonant stem takes -은 적이.
Experiential past construction: verb stem + -(으)ㄴ 적이 있다 ('have the experience of doing'); negative: -(으)ㄴ 적이 없다 (한국에 가 본 적이 있어요/없어요).
Expository communication verb (說明 + 하다 = to explain / elucidate); takes topic with -을/를 and listener with -에게 (이유를 설명하다, 문법을 설명하다).
Express bus terminal; takes locative -에서 with 고속버스를 타다 or directional -에 가다.
Extreme degree adverb ('too / excessively'). Prescriptively negative/excessive (너무 비싸요), but colloquially used for strong positive emphasis (너무 좋아요).
Eyewear loanword; counter is 개. Strictly takes eyewear verbs 쓰다 or 끼다 (선글라스를 끼다/쓰다) and 벗다.
Facility venue (art museum); takes locative -에서 with 그림을 감상하다 / 구경하다.
Facility venue (zoo); takes locative -에서 with 동물을 구경하다 / 보다.
Familiar/accustomed adjective; takes target with dative -에 (한국 생활에 익숙해요). Antonym is 낯설다.
Fashion accessory loanword; collocates with wearing verb 하다 (액세서리를 하다) and 사다.
Fashion neckwear loanword noun (scarf); paired with wearable verb 매다 (스카프를 매다 = wear a scarf) or 하다.

Female given name (Marie / 마리); proper noun used as dialogue persona; takes title 마리 씨; subject particle 마리가 / 마리 씨는; homonym: distinct from animal counter 마리 (匹 = counter for animals: 개 두 마리, 고양이 한 마리).
Female Western given name (Maria / 마리아); proper noun for foreign language exchange students / textbook dialogue persona; takes polite vocative/honorific title 마리아 씨; subject particle 마리아가 / 마리아 씨는.
Film genre compound noun (melodrama + 映畵 = romantic movie / romantic drama); counter 편; collocations: 슬픈 멜로 영화.
Film genre compound noun (家族映畵 = family movie); counter 편 / 개; collocations: 가족 영화를 보다 / 추천하다.
Film genre compound noun (恐怖映畵 = horror film / scary movie); collocations: 공포 영화를 보다 / 무서워하다; counter 편.
Film genre compound noun (戰爭映畵 = war film / military drama); counter 편; collocations: 감동적인 전쟁 영화.
Film genre compound noun (漫畵映畵 = animated cartoon / anime / animated film); counter 편; synonym 애니메이션.
Film genre compound noun (空想科學映畵 = science fiction / sci-fi movie; often abbreviated SF영화); counter 편.
Financial activity noun (換錢 = money exchange / currency exchange); forms 환전하다 (exchange currency); collocates with 환전소 (exchange booth), 환율 (exchange rate).
Financial compound noun (信用 + card = credit card); contrast with 체크카드 (debit card); collocations: 신용카드로 계산하다 / 결제하다, 신용카드를 발급받다.
Financial dues noun (會費 = membership fee / club dues / gathering expense share); collocates with 회비를 내다/걷다 (pay/collect dues).
Financial healthcare noun (治療費 = medical expenses / cost of treatment); collocations: 치료비가 들다 / 나오다 (treatment costs incur), 치료비를 지원하다.
Financial insurance noun (旅行者保險 = traveler's insurance); collocations: 여행자 보험에 가입하다 / 들다 (sign up for travel insurance).
Financial loanword noun (check card = debit card linked directly to bank account); contrast with 신용카드 (credit card); collocates with 체크카드로 결제하다 / 계산하다.
Financial noun (現金 = cash / ready physical money); collocations: 현금으로 내다 / 결제하다 (pay in cash), 현금영수증 (cash tax deduction receipt).
Financial noun (貯金 = savings / money saved / deposit); forms 저금하다 (to save/deposit money); collocates with 저금통 (piggy bank), 매달 저금하다.
Financial noun and noun-adverb (無料 = free of charge / gratis); adverbial phrase 무료로 (무료로 주다, 무료로 이용하다); antonym 유료 (有料 = paid); collocations: 무료 배송 (free delivery).
Financial payment verb (決濟하다 = settle a bill / make payment); distinct from 결재하다 (approval sign-off); collocations: 카드로 결제하다, 간편 결제 (easy payment); stem 결제하- -> 결제해요 / 결제해서.
Fitness activity; collocates with 하다 (요가를 하다) or 배우다 (요가를 배우다).
Fixed academic aspect VP ('school vacation ends'); antonym is 방학이 시작되다.
Fixed academic aspect VP ('school vacation starts'); antonym is 방학이 끝나다.
Fixed academic aspect VP ('semester begins'); antonym is 학기가 끝나다.
Fixed academic aspect VP ('semester ends'); antonym is 학기가 시작되다.
Fixed celebration VP predicate; stem verb 자르다 is 르-irregular (케이크를 잘라요).
Fixed celebration VP; stem verb 불다 is ㄹ-irregular (풍선을 불어요, 풍선을 붑니다).
Fixed cognate predicate (그림 + 을 + 그리다 = draw/paint a picture).
Fixed hospitality greeting ('Welcome / Please come in'); formulaic opening by shopkeepers and hosts.
Fixed phone predicate ('to answer the phone'); antonym of 전화를 끊다 (hang up).
Fixed photographic predicate (사진 + 을 + 찍다 = take a picture/photo).
Fixed picnic/outing VP; collocates with 공원, 날씨가 좋다, and packing lunches (도시락을 싸다).
Fixed planning VP (計劃 + 을 세우다 = to make a plan); collocates with 여행 계획, 방학 계획.
Fixed predicate meaning 'to have no plans/appointments'; antonym of 약속이 있다.
Fixed predicate meaning 'to have plans/appointments'; antonym of 약속이 없다.
Fixed rain gear VP ('to use/put up an umbrella'); stem verb 쓰다 is ㅡ-irregular (우산을 써요).
Fixed smoking VP; standard public prohibition formula: 여기서 담배를 피우면 안 됩니다.
Fixed telephone VP ('to hang up/end a call'); stem verb 끊다 has ㅎ coda phonetics [끈타/끄너요].
Fixed telephone VP ('to place/dial a phone call'); stem verb 걸다 is ㄹ-irregular (전화를 걸어요, 전화를 겁니다). Takes recipient with -에게/한테.
Fixed telephone VP ('to transfer/put someone on the phone'); polite request formula: [Person] 좀 바꿔 주세요.
Fixed text messaging VP ('to receive a text message'); takes source with -에게서/한테서.
Fixed text messaging VP ('to send a text message'); takes recipient with -에게/한테.
Fixed travel VP ('to go on a trip'); takes destination with allative -으로/로 (제주도로 여행을 가다).
Fixed VP predicate; stem verb 고르다 is 르-irregular (선물을 골라요).
Fixed VP predicate; stem verb 부르다 is 르-irregular (생일축하 노래를 불러요).
Fixed VP predicate; ㅡ-irregular verb 쓰다 (카드를 써요). Takes dative recipient with -에게/한테.
Flat counter is 장 (한 장, 두 장). Collocates with verbs 예매하다, 사다, 끊다.
Flat thickness adjective (clothes, paper); antonym of 두껍다. Contrasts with slender dimension 가늘다.
Flower noun; counter is 송이 (Pure Korean numbers: 장미 세 송이). Collocates with 선물하다.
Folding verb ('to fold / bend / shelve idea'); takes object with -을/를 (종이를 접다 = fold paper, 우산을 접다, 꿈을 접다); antonym is 펴다 (unfold).
Footwear donning verb; strictly restricted to items worn on feet (신발, 구두, 운동화, 양말, 슬리퍼). Antonym is 벗다.
Footwear loanword; pair counter is 켤레. Strictly takes footwear verb 신다 (슬리퍼를 신다).
Form/appearance noun (模樣 = shape / form / design / appearance); collocates with 별 모양 (star shape), 하트 모양; bound noun -(으)ㄴ/는 모양이다 (it appears that...).

Formal high-polite imperative sentence ender (하하십시오체: 'please do...'); attaches strictly to Action verb stems: stem with final consonant takes -으십시오 (앉으십시오, 읽으십시오, 찾으십시오), stem with vowel or ㄹ final takes -십시오 (가십시오, 오십시오, 만드십시오); public announcements, official speeches, written instructions; honorific suppletion: 드십시오 (eat/drink), 주무십시오 (sleep).
Formal polite contrastive connective (-습니다 + 만 = '..., but / however'); high formal register (하십시오체); common in announcements, business, and polite service refusals (죄송합니다만, 감사합니다만).
Formal register: Sino-Korean polite equivalent of 밥을 먹다
Formal utilization verb (使用 + 하다 = to use / employ / utilize); takes tool, device, or language with -을/를 (컴퓨터를 사용하다, 존댓말을 사용하다); synonym is 쓰다.
Formal/written adversative conjunctive adverb (然而 = but / however / yet); sentence-initial in formal register and literature (노력했다. 그러나 실패했다); more formal than 하지만 / 그런데.
Frequency adverb ('often/frequently'); placed immediately preceding the verb/predicate.
Frequency adverb ('sometimes / occasionally'); placed preceding verb/predicate.
Frequency adverb (恒常 = always / constantly; synonym 언제나); modifies predicates (항상 고맙다, 항상 열심히 하다).
Frequency counter: pairs with Pure Korean numbers (한 번, 두 번)
Frequently contracted colloquially to 애. Counter is 명 (person counter) or formal 분.
Freshness adjective (新鮮하다); modifies seafood, vegetables, fruits, air (공기), or ideas (신선한 발상).
Fruit loanword; individual counter is 개, bunch counter is 송이. Collocates with 먹다.
Fruit noun ('Korean yellow melon'); counter: 개; collocates with 참외를 깎다/먹다.
Fruit noun (葡萄 = grape); counter: 송이 (cluster); collocates with 포도를 따다/씻다/먹다.
Full interrogative pronoun for objects; contracts to 뭐 in colloquial speech and 뭘 when taking accusative marker -을 (무엇을 -> 뭘).
Furniture loanword noun ('sofa / couch'); collocates with 앉다 (소파에 앉다 / 누워 있다).
Furniture noun (옷 + 欌 = wardrobe / clothes closet); collocates with 옷장에 옷을 걸다/넣다.
Furniture noun (食卓 = dining table); collocates with 차리다 (식탁을 차리다 = set table), 식탁에 앉다.
Future/intentional ending: vowel or ㄹ stem takes -ㄹ 거예요, consonant stem takes -을 거예요. Expresses 1st person intention or 3rd person probability.
Future/prospective adnominal modifier suffix on verbs/adjectives (갈 곳, 먹을 음식, 예쁠 사람); vowel/ㄹ stem takes -ㄹ, consonant takes -을.
Gastrointestinal symptom noun (배 + 脫 = stomach trouble / upset stomach); strongly collocates with 배탈이 나다 (get an upset stomach; 찬 음식을 먹고 배탈이 났어요).
General color noun (색 + 깔 = color); collocates with 색깔이 예쁘다/밝다/어둡다, 무슨 색깔.
General communication verb (連絡 + 하다); takes person with -에게/한테 or comitative -와/과.
General footwear category; counter is 켤레. Strictly takes footwear verbs 신다 (put on) and 벗다 (take off).
General greeting verb (人事 + 하다); takes addressee with -에게/한테.
General object counter; strictly requires Pure Korean attributive numerals (한, 두, 세, 네, 다섯... 개).
General phoning verb (電話 + 하다); takes recipient with -에게/한테.
General speaking verb; takes listener with -에게/한테 and topic with -에 대해 or content with direct object -을/를.
General un-wearing verb ('to take off clothes / shoes / glasses / hat'); takes all wearable items with -을/를 (옷을 벗다, 신발을 벗다, 모자를 벗다); antonyms are 입다/신다/쓰다/끼다.
Gentle/polite interrogative ending ('Is it? / Does it?'); attaches directly to action verb stems (가나요, 먹나요), past tense stems (갔나요), and 있다/없다 (있나요).
Gentle/polite interrogative ending for descriptive verbs ('Is it?'); vowel stems take -ㄴ가요 (예쁜가요), consonant stems take -은가요 (좋은가요); copula takes 인가요.
Geographic and conceptual noun (世界 = the world / the globe); collocations: 세계 여행을 하다 (travel the world), 전 세계 (around the world), 세계 지도 (world map).

Geographic city proper noun (大田 = Daejeon, metropolitan city in central South Korea, transportation hub); collocations: 대전역 (Daejeon Station), 대전행 열차 (train bound for Daejeon), 대전에 살다 / 가다; locative particles -에 / -에서.
Geographic city proper noun (春川 = Chuncheon, provincial capital of Gangwon Province); collocations: 춘천 닭갈비, 춘천행 기차; locative -에 가다 / -에서 살다.
Geographic continent proper noun (Asia = 아시아); collocations: 아시아 대륙 (Asian continent), 아시아 국가 (Asian countries), 동아시아 (East Asia); locative -에 가다 / -에서 살다.
Geographic country noun (러시아 = Russia / Россия); collocations: 러시아어 (Russian language), 러시아 사람 (Russian person), 모스크바 (Moscow); locative -에 가다 / -에서 오다.
Geographic country noun (獨逸 / Deutschland = Germany); collocations: 독일어 (German language), 독일 사람 / 독일인 (German person), 독일 베를린 (Berlin, Germany); locative -에 가다 / -에서 오다.
Geographic noun ('countryside / rural hometown'); antonym is 도시 (city); collocates with 시골에 살다, 시골에 내려가다.
Geographic proper noun (東海 = East Sea of Korea); antonym is 서해; locative -에서 (동해에서 일출을 보다).
Geographic proper noun (西海 = West Sea / Yellow Sea of Korea); antonym is 동해 (East Sea).
Geographic tourism proper noun (南怡島 = Nami Island in Chuncheon); famous cultural filming location; locative -에 가다 / -에서 관광하다.
Geographical noun ('island'); collocates with 제주도, 무인도; counter: 개.
Gift certificate noun (商品券); flat counter is 장. Collocates with 선물하다 and 쓰다.
Gift compound noun (꽃 + 바구니 = flower basket); collocates with 꽃바구니를 선물하다/전달하다.
Gift noun; collocates with verbs 주다/받다/사다 and light verb 선물하다.
Gradual progressive adverb ('gradually / more and more'); strongly collocates with change-of-state predicates (점점 추워지다, 점점 좋아지다).
Graduate school noun (Sino-Korean 大學院); takes allative -에 with 진학하다/다니다/들어가다 and ablative -에서 with 졸업하다.
Graduation verb (卒業 + 하다); takes school with accusative -을/를 (대학교를 졸업하다) or source -에서 졸업하다; antonym is 입학하다.

Grammatical linguistic noun (接續詞 = conjunction / connective word); collocations: 문장 접속사, 대등/종속 접속사 (coordinating/subordinating conjunctions); describes discourse connectives like 그래도, 그러나, 그러면, 하지만, 왜냐하면.
Grammatical linguistic term ('ㅎ-irregular verbs / adjectives', e.g. 그렇다, 파랗다, 하얗다); drops ㅎ and vowel contracts before vowel suffixes (-아/어 -> -애/얘, -(으)ㄴ -> -ㄴ).
Graphic information noun (略圖 = rough sketch map / simplified directions map); collocates with 약도를 그리다, 약도를 보내다.
Grip noun (손 + 잡이 = handle / subway strap / doorknob); collocates with 손잡이를 잡다 (hold on to subway handrail).
Grocery market loanword (often shortened to 슈퍼); takes locative -에서 with 장을 보다 / 음식을 사다.
Hangul Day national holiday (October 9th); pronounced [한글랄] via liquidization (유음화).
Harmony/suitability predicate ('to suit / look good on / get along with'); takes target with -에게 or -와/과 (이 옷이 너에게 잘 어울려요; 친구들과 잘 어울리다).
Hat/headwear noun (帽子); counter is 개. Strictly takes headwear verb 쓰다 (모자를 쓰다) and 벗다.
Headwear/eyewear donning verb; collocates with 모자 (hat), 안경 (glasses), 마스크 (mask), and 우산 (umbrella). Antonym is 벗다.
Health adjective (健康 + 하다); takes person as subject. Conventional greeting/wish: 건강하세요 (Be healthy / Stay well).
Healthcare occupational noun (藥師 = licensed pharmacist); addressed politely as 약사님; counter 분 / 명; workplace 약국 (pharmacy).
Hesitation filler / polite conversation starter ('Uhm / Excuse me'); homonym with 1st person humble pronoun 저 and demonstrative 저.
Hesitation/deliberation interjection ('um / mmm / well'); signals contemplation or assent (음, 글쎄요, 음, 맛있네요).
High-degree adverb ('very'); modifies adjectives and adverbs (아주 좋다, 아주 잘하다).

High-frequency intransitive emergence verb; subject takes -이/가: (1) physiological (열이 나다, 땀이 나다, 콧물이 나다), (2) incidents (사고가 나다, 불이 나다), (3) sensory (소리가 나다, 냄새가 나다), (4) emotions (화가 나다); conjugates 나요 / 나서.
Higher education venue; takes allative -에 with 다니다 (대학교에 다니다 = attend university).
Highly polysemous causative verb: (1) pay money/fees (돈/요금을 내다); (2) submit homework/documents (숙제를 내다); (3) cause accidents/fire (사고를 내다, 불을 내다); (4) make time (시간을 내다).
Highly polysemous verb: (1) hold/carry in hand (가방을 들다); (2) cost money/time (돈/시간이 들다); (3) enter/lodge (마음에 들다, 잠이 들다, 나이가 들다); ㄹ-irregular stem.
Historic avenue proper noun (鍾路 = Bell Street / historic central avenue of Seoul); locative -에서.
Historic landmark proper noun (光化門 = main southern gate of Gyeongbokgung Palace / Gwanghwamun Square); locative -에서.
Historical temporal noun (old days / ancient times / the past); collocations: 옛날이야기 (ancient tale / folklore), 옛날에 살던 곳, 옛날 사람.
Holiday noun; takes time particle -에 (크리스마스에).
Home appliance noun (扇風機 = electric cooling fan); counter 대; collocations: 선풍기를 틀다 / 켜다 (turn on fan), 선풍기를 끄다 (turn off fan), 선풍기 바람.
Home appliance noun (洗濯機 = washing machine); collocates with 돌리다 (세탁기를 돌리다 = run washing machine); counter: 대.
Honorific dative particle ('to/for'); counterpart of -에게/-한테. Strictly governs humble verbs (드리다, 말씀드리다, 여쭙다).
Honorific demonstrative person: requires honorific predicate concord (-시- / 드리다)
Honorific nominative/subject particle; counterpart of -이/-가. Strictly governs subject honorific infix -(으)시- on the predicate.

Honorific person noun and counter (分 = person [honorific] / counter for people); (1) noun: 저 분 (that esteemed person), 어떤 분 (which person); (2) counter: 세 분 (three esteemed people); honorific counterpart of 사람 / 명.
Honorific proximal person pronoun (이 + 분); contrasts with plain 이 사람. Requires honorific verb concord (-(으)시-).
Honorific suppletive noun for age (年歲 = honorific for 나이); used for elderly persons or elders (연세가 어떻게 되세요?, 연세가 많으시다).
Honorific suppletive noun for meal/rice (進御/진지 = honorific for 밥); collocates with suppletive honorific verbs (진지 드셨어요? / 진지 잡수세요).
Honorific suppletive noun for name (姓銜 = honorific for 이름); used when asking senior or customer's name (성함이 어떻게 되세요?).
Horticultural noun (花盆 = flowerpot / potted plant); counter: 개; collocates with 화분에 물을 주다.
Hospitality accommodation noun (客室 = hotel guest room / cabin); counter 실 / 개; collocations: 객실을 예약하다, 객실 요금 (room rate), 2인실 객실.
Hospitality verb (宿泊하다 = lodge / stay overnight); argument frame: [Accommodation]에서 숙박하다 (호텔/펜션에서 숙박하다); collocations: 숙박비 (lodging cost), 숙박 시설.
Hour counter: strictly takes Pure Korean numbers (한 시, 두 시, 세 시), not Sino-Korean numbers
Household chore verb (설거지하다 = wash dishes / do the dishes); collocations: 밥을 먹은 후에 설거지하다, 싱크대에서 설거지하다; stem 설거지하- -> 설거지해요 / 설거지해서.
Household cleaning verb (걸레질하다 = to wipe with a damp cloth / mop); accusative -을/를 (방바닥을 걸레질하다); stem 걸레질하- -> 걸레질해요 / 걸레질해서.
Household fabric noun (手巾 = towel); collocates with 닦다 (수건으로 닦다); counter: 장.
Humble 1st person plural pronoun (저 + 희 = we / us / our); lowers the speaker's group when speaking to an honored addressee (저희 집, 저희 나라 - avoid 저희 나라, use 우리 나라 in standard national context).
Humble communication verb (speaker contacting superior); takes honorific dative -께 (교수님께 연락드리다).
Humble greeting verb (speaker greeting superior); takes honorific dative -께 (어르신께 인사드리다).
Humble phoning verb (speaker calling superior); takes honorific dative -께 (어머니께 전화드리다).
Humble speech verb (speaker telling a superior); takes recipient with -께 (부모님께 말씀드리다). Contrasts with 말씀하시다 (superior speaking).
Idiomatic compound predicate (배 + 가 + 고프다). Irregular ㅡ conjugation (고파요). Subject marker -가 is frequently omitted in colloquial speech (배고파요).
Idiomatic gesture predicate (拍手를 + 치다 = to clap hands / applaud); takes recipient with -에게 (연주자에게 박수를 치다).
Idiomatic health verb phrase (voice becomes hoarse / lose voice); stem 목이 쉬- -> 목이 쉬어요 / 쉬어서 (노래를 많이 불러서 목이 쉬었어요); attributive 목이 쉰 소리 (hoarse voice).
Idiomatic intransitive verb phrase (화가 + 나다 = anger arises / to get angry); takes cause/target with -에게/-한테 화가 나다; contrast with 화를 내다 (deliberately vent/express anger).
Idiomatic state predicate (마음에 + 들다 = to enter one's heart / to like / be appealing); takes liked object with -이/가 (이 옷이 마음에 들어요).
Idiomatic VP predicate ('to keep one\'s promise/appointment'); antonym is 약속을 어기다.
Idiomatic VP predicate; takes locative -에서 (한강공원에서 자전거를 타다).
Illness noun (感氣 = common cold / flu); collocations: 감기에 걸리다 (catch a cold), 감기가 낫다 (recover from a cold), 감기 조심하세요 (be careful not to catch a cold).
Immediate past temporal adverb (方今 = just now / a moment ago); frequently paired with past tense (방금 도착했어요, 방금 들었어요); synonym 방금 전, 막.
Immediate sequence connective clause (-자마자 = 'as soon as / the moment that'); attaches directly to Action verb stems without batchim distinction (집에 도착하자마자 쉬었어요, 수업이 끝나자마자 나갔어요).
Impossibility/inability construction: verb stem + -(으)ㄹ 수 없다; expresses lack of ability or situational impossibility.

Inability and poor proficiency verb: (1) auxiliary negation: -지 못하다 (가지 못하다 = cannot go); (2) independent transitive verb of poor skill: [Skill]을/를 못하다 (수영을 못하다, 한국말을 못하다 = poor at swimming/Korean; antonym 잘하다); distinct from negative adverb 못 (word spacing: 못 하다 = unable to do vs 못하다 = poor at).
Inability negation (short 못 + Verb, long Verb stem + -지 못하다); expresses external circumstance/inability, contrasting with volitional negation 안 / -지 않다. Restricted to action verbs.
Inanimate bringing verb ('to bring [object]'); contrasts with animate peer 데리고 오다 and honorific 모시고 오다.
Inception verb (始作 + 하다 = to begin / start); takes verbal noun with -을/를 (공부를 시작하다) or -기 시작하다; antonym is 끝나다 / 마치다.
Inchoative change-of-state suffix on adjective stems ('to become/get ...'); attaches via -아/어/여 (e.g. 따뜻해지다, 추워지다, 익숙해지다); converts descriptive verb to action verb.
Incident noun (事故 = accident / incident / mishap); collocations: 사고가 나다 (accident happens), 교통사고 (traffic accident), 사고를 내다 / 당하다.

Indirect declarative reported speech ('said that...'); Action verbs: consonant takes -는다고 하다 (먹는다고 해요), vowel takes -ㄴ다고 하다 (간다고 해요); Descriptive verbs take -다고 하다 (예쁘다고 해요, 좋다고 해요); nouns take (이)라고 하다.

Indirect imperative reported speech ('told / ordered someone to do X'); Action verb stems: consonant takes -으라고 하다 (앉으라고 했어요, 먹으라고 해요), vowel/ㄹ takes -라고 하다 (가라고 했어요, 만들라고 했어요); negative is -지 말라고 하다.
Indirect interrogative reported speech ('asked if / whether'); Action verbs and Descriptive verbs take -(으)냐고 하다 / -냐고 하다 (어디 가냐고 했어요, 춥냐고 물어봤어요); nouns take (이)냐고 하다.
Indirect propositive reported speech ('suggested / proposed that we do X'); attaches directly to Action verb stems without batchim distinction (같이 가자고 했어요, 밥을 먹자고 해요); negative is -지 말자고 하다.
Indirect question cognitive construction: verb stem + -는지 알다/모르다 ('to know / not know whether/how/where...'); descriptive verbs take -(으)ㄴ지 알다; copula takes 인지 알다.

Indirect request reported speech when favoring a third party ('told me to do X for someone else'); verb stem + -아/어 주라고 하다 (동생을 도와주라고 하셨어요 = parents told me to help my younger sibling); contrast with -어 달라고 하다.

Indirect request reported speech when favoring the original speaker ('asked to do X for me/them'); verb stem + -아/어 달라고 하다 (도와 달라고 했어요 = asked me to help him/her, 사진을 찍어 달라고 해요); contrast with -어 주라고 하다.
Informal 2nd person plural pronoun ('you all / you guys'); used with peers and juniors (너희 둘이 친하니?); possessive 너희의 -> 너희; polite/formal equivalent is 여러분.
Informal intimate affirmative discourse marker ('yes / alright / okay / sure'); pan말 response to suggestions or questions (그래, 내일 보자).
Informal intimate prohibitive ending (반말 imperative of -지 말다: 'don't do X'); attaches directly to action verb stem (가지 마, 울지 마, 걱정하지 마); polite form is -지 마세요.
Informal non-polite intimate speech level (반말); formed by dropping 요 from -아/어요 (가, 먹어, 좋아); used between close friends, to younger people, or within immediate family.
Inherently honorific noun (父母 + -님); requires honorific particle -께서 and subject honorific verb concord (-(으)시-).
Inquiry verb (質問 + 하다 = to ask a question / interrogate); takes question with -을/를 and addressee with -에게 (선생님에게 질문하다); antonym is 대답하다.
Insertion verb ('to put in / insert / add'); takes object with -을/를 and destination with -에 (가방에 책을 넣다, 찌개에 파를 넣다); antonym is 꺼내다 / 빼다.
Insertion/affixing verb ('to stick in / plug in / skewer'; standardly 꽂다); takes object with -을/를 and target with -에 (플러그를 콘센트에 꽂다, 꼬치에 고기를 꽂다).
Institutional amenities noun (施設 = facilities / amenities); collocations: 편의 시설 (convenience amenities), 시설이 깨끗하다 / 좋다, 공공 시설 (public facilities).
Institutional healthcare noun (健康保險 = national health insurance); collocations: 건강 보험증 (health insurance card), 건강 보험료 (insurance premium).
Institutional matriculation verb (入學하다 = enter school / matriculate); argument frame: [School]에 입학하다 (대학교에 입학하다); antonym 졸업하다 (graduate); collocations: 입학식 (matriculation ceremony).
Instrumental particle ('by / with / using / via'); marks tool, vehicle, language, or material; vowel/ㄹ takes -로 (버스로, 연필로, 한국말로), consonant takes -으로 (지하철로, 손으로).
Instrumental physical verb phrase (발로 + 차다 = kick with foot); takes target with -을/를 (공을 발로 차다, 문을 발로 차다).
Intellectual adjective ('smart / clever'); takes person/child as subject; collocates with 머리가 좋다.
Intentional conditional connective (-(으)려고 하면 contraction: 'if one intends to / in order to do'); apodosis typically requires modal obligation -아/어야 하다 or recommendation (한국어를 잘하려면 매일 연습해야 해요).

Intentional/purposive connective suffix ('in order to / with the intention of doing'); vowel/ㄹ take -려고, consonant takes -으려고; cannot take future -겠- or past -았/었- in dependent clause; cannot be followed by imperative/propositive ending.
Intercity express bus noun; terminal is 고속버스터미널. Takes verb 타다.
International telephone country code noun; digits read in Sino-Korean numerals.

Interpersonal promise/volitional ending ('I will ... / I promise to ...'); strictly restricted to 1st person subject making immediate responsive commitment to addressee (제가 도와줄게요, 내일 연락할게요); cannot be used in questions.
Interrogative adjective ('how / what kind of'); ㅎ-irregular: 어때요 / 어떻습니까 / 어떤 (adnominal interrogative determiner, e.g. 어떤 사람); collocates with 어떻게 (adverbial: how).
Interrogative adverb of manner/method ('how'); transit formula: [Place]에 어떻게 가요? Polite inquiry: 어떻게 되세요?
Interrogative adverb of reason/cause; questions trigger causal answer endings (-아/어서, -(으)니까, -기 때문에).
Interrogative extent/duration adverb; standard travel duration inquiry: 얼마나 걸려요?
Interrogative person pronoun; contracts irregularly with nominative marker -가 to form 누가 (*누구가 is ungrammatical).
Interrogative pronoun of quantity and price; standard inquiry formula: 얼마예요? Can modify duration: 얼마 동안.
Interrupted progression clause connective ('while doing X, [interrupted by/transitioning into Y]'); attaches directly to action verb stems (가다가 넘어졌어요, 텔레비전을 보다가 잠이 들었어요).
Interrupted/reversal sequence connective (-았/었다가 = 'did X and then shifted/reverted to Y'); subjects in both clauses must be identical (비행기 표를 샀다가 취소했어요, 백화점에 갔다가 친구를 만났어요).
Intersection noun (사 + 거리 = 4-way intersection); standard waypoint in giving directions (사거리에서 오른쪽으로 가세요).
Intransitive ascension and increase verb (to rise / climb / go up); argument frame: [Mountain]에 오르다 (산에 오르다), 물가/기온이 오르다; reu-irregular (올라요 / 올라서 / 오르면); antonym 내리다.
Intransitive assembly verb ('to gather / assemble / congregate'); takes subject with -이/가 (사람들이 모이다, 동창들이 모이다); paired transitive is 모으다.
Intransitive cessation verb (to stop / cease); subject takes -이/가: 비가 그치다 (rain stops), 눈이 그치다 (snow ceases), 울음을 그치다 (stop weeping); stem 그치- -> 그쳐요 / 그쳐서.
Intransitive dynamic locomotion verb (to run / race / sprint); collocations: 빠르게 달리다 (run quickly), 운동장을 달리다; stem 달리- -> 달려요 / 달려서; synonym 뛰다.
Intransitive floral blooming verb (꽃이 피다); antonym is 지다 (꽃이 지다 = wither/fall). Contrasts with transitive causative 피우다.
Intransitive hygiene compound verb; takes locative -에서 (화장실에서 샤워하다).
Intransitive hygiene verb; takes locative -에서 (화장실에서 세수하다).
Intransitive inchoative verb ('to begin / get started'); takes event subject with -이/가 (학기가 시작되다). Contrasts with transitive 시작하다.
Intransitive leisure verb; takes locative -에서 (백화점/마트에서 쇼핑하다) or accusative 쇼핑을 하다.

Intransitive life-event verb (태어나다 = to be born); syntactic frames: locative origin [Place]에서 태어나다 (한국에서 태어났어요), temporal origin [Time]에 태어나다 (1995년에 태어났어요); stem 태어나- -> 태어나요 / 태어나서 / 태어났습니다 (predominantly used in past tense -았/었다).
Intransitive malfunction verb phrase (故障 나다 = break down / malfunction); subject takes -이/가 (스마트폰이 고장 났다, 에어컨이 고장 나서); antonym 고치다 (repair).
Intransitive outdoor activity verb (산에 가다 / 산에서 등산하다). Nominal form 등산 combines with 하다 or 가다.
Intransitive phone VP ('phone is ringing / call is coming in'); takes caller with -에게서/한테서.
Intransitive private home lodging verb (民泊 + 하다); takes location with -에서 (한옥마을에서 민박하다).

Intransitive recovery verb (to heal / get well / recover from illness); subject takes -이/가 (감기가 낫다, 상처가 낫다); s-irregular: drops ㅅ before vowels (나아요 / 나아서 / 나으면), retains before consonants (낫고 / 낫습니다).
Intransitive remnant verb (to remain / be left over); subject takes -이/가 (음식이 남다 = food is left over, 시간이 남다 = time remains); stem 남- -> 남아요 / 남아서; causative counterpart is 남기다.
Intransitive s-irregular symptom verb (to swell / puff up); subject takes -이/가 (목이 붓다, 다리가 붓다, 얼굴이 부었어요); drops ㅅ before vowels (부어요 / 부어서 / 부으면), retains before consonants (붓고).
Intransitive verb meaning 'to wake up' or 'to stand up/rise'; takes temporal particle -에 (아침에 일어나다).
Intransitive verb taking subject marker -이/가 (수업이 끝나다). Contrasts with transitive 끝내다 (숙제를 끝내다).
Intransitive verb; takes locative -에서 (집에서 쉬다) or temporal -에 (주말에 쉬다).

Involuntary/circumstantial change of state construction: verb stem + -게 되다 ('to come to / end up doing / turn out to'); indicates transition caused by external factors rather than speaker's deliberate will (한국에 오게 되었어요, 알게 되다).
Inward motion verb ('to enter / go in'); antonym of 나오다/나가다. Takes destination with -에 (방에 들어가다).
Itinerary schedule noun (日程 = daily itinerary / travel schedule); collocations: 여행 일정 (travel itinerary), 일정을 잡다 / 취소하다, 빡빡한 일정.
Jewelry / wrist accessory noun (팔 + 찌 = bracelet / bangle); paired with verb 차다 (팔찌를 차다) or 하다 (팔찌를 하다); counter 개.
