Transit stop noun (停留場); specifically 버스 정류장 (bus stop). Takes locative -에서 with 버스를 기다리다/타다.
Transitive accumulation verb (to pile up / stack / build); accusative -을/를: (1) physical objects (벽돌을 쌓다, 눈이 쌓이다 [passive]), (2) abstract accumulation (경험을/실력을 쌓다); stem 쌓- -> 쌓아요 / 쌓아서.
Transitive aggregation verb ('to collect / save / gather'); ㅡ-irregular: 모아요 / 모아서; takes object with -을/를 (돈을 모으다 = save money, 우표를 모으다 = collect stamps); paired intransitive is 모이다.
Transitive causative delivery verb (配達시키다 = order delivery); accusative -을/를 (음식/치킨/피자를 배달시키다); stem 배달시키- -> 배달시켜요 / 배달시켜서.
Transitive causative reduction verb (to reduce / decrease / lessen / cut down); accusative -을/를 (비용을 줄이다, 소리를 줄이다, 쓰레기를 줄이다); stem 줄이- -> 줄여요 / 줄여서; antonym 늘리다.
Transitive cognitive decision verb (決定하다 = to decide / determine / resolve); accusative -을/를 (날짜를 결정하다, 메뉴를 결정하다); stem 결정하- -> 결정해요 / 결정해서; synonym 정하다.
Transitive cognitive verb (to forget); accusative -을/를 (이름을/약속을/단어를 잊다); stem 잊- -> 잊어요 / 잊어서; emphatic compound 잊어버리다; antonym 기억하다.
Transitive cognitive verb (理解하다 = to understand / comprehend); accusative -을/를 (말/내용/상황을 이해하다 = understand speech/content/situation); stem 이해하- -> 이해해요 / 이해해서 / 이해했습니다.
Transitive completion verb ('to finish / complete / wrap up'); takes task with -을/를 (숙제를 끝내다, 일을 끝내다); paired intransitive is 끝나다 (일이 끝나다).
Transitive completion verb (to finish / complete / wrap up); accusative -을/를 (수업/회의/일을 마치다); stem 마치- -> 마쳐요 / 마쳐서; synonym 끝내다.
Transitive elevation and posting verb; accusative -을/를: (1) physical raise (손을 올리다), (2) price/rate increase (가격을 올리다), (3) digital upload (사진/글을 인터넷에 올리다); stem 올리- -> 올려요 / 올려서; antonym 내리다.
Transitive financial acquisition verb (to earn money / make a living); accusative -을/를 (돈을 벌다); l-irregular: drops ㄹ before ㄴ/ㅅ/ㅂ (법니다, 버는, 버세요; 벌면 / 벌어서).
Transitive hedonic verb (to enjoy / take pleasure in / relish); accusative -을/를 (음악을 즐기다, 여가를 즐기다, 인생을 즐겨라); stem 즐기- -> 즐겨요 / 즐겨서.
Transitive hygiene verb (to wash / rinse); regular ㅅ-stem verb (NOT s-irregular: 씻어 / 씻어요 / 씻어서); collocates with 손을 씻다, 발을 씻다, 얼굴을 씻다, 과일을 씻다.
Transitive presentation verb (紹介하다 = to introduce / present); double object frame [Target]에게 [Entity]을/를 소개하다 (친구에게 한국을 소개하다, 자기소개하다); stem 소개하- -> 소개해요 / 소개해서.
Transitive remedial verb: (1) fix/repair device (기계를 고치다, 휴대폰을 고치다), (2) correct/revise text or habits (문장을 고치다, 버릇을 고치다); synonym 수리하다.
Transitive removal verb (to erase / delete / wipe off); takes accusative -을/를: 글씨/낙서를 지우다 (erase writing), 사진/파일을 지우다 (delete digital files), 화장을 지우다 (remove makeup); conjugates 지워요 / 지워서.
Transitive retrieval/mention verb: (1) take out physical object from container [Source]에서 [Object]을/를 꺼내다 (가방에서 책을 꺼내다), (2) bring up a conversation topic (말을 꺼내다); conjugates 꺼내요 / 꺼내서.
Transitive reu-irregular verb (to apply / smear / spread substance on surface); argument frame: [Place]에 [Substance]을/를 바르다 (상처에 연고를 바르다, 얼굴에 크림을 바르다); 르-irregular paradigm (발라요 / 발라서 / 바르면).
Transitive s-irregular liquid verb (to pour / fill liquid into a container); argument frame: [Container]에 [Liquid]을/를 붓다 (냄비에 물을 붓다); s-irregular paradigm (부어요 / 부어서 / 부으면).

Transitive s-irregular verb (to connect / link / join / continue); accusative -을/를 (길을 잇다, 실을 잇다); s-irregular paradigm: drops ㅅ before vowels (이어요 / 이어서 / 이으면), retains before consonants (잇고 / 잇습니다).
Transitive s-irregular verb: (1) draw a line (줄/선을 긋다), (2) strike a match (성냥을 긋다); s-irregular paradigm: drops ㅅ before vowels (그어 / 그어요 / 그으면), retains before consonants (긋고 / 긋습니다).
Transitive s-irregular verb: (1) stir liquid (커피를 젓다, 국을 젓다), (2) row a boat (노를 젓다), (3) shake head negatively (고개를 젓다); s-irregular paradigm (저어요 / 저어서 / 저으면; 젓고).
Transitive sweeping verb (to sweep with a broom); accusative -을/를 (바닥을 쓸다, 마당을 쓸다); l-irregular paradigm: drops ㄹ before ㄴ/ㅅ/ㅂ (씁니다, 쓰는), retains before vowels (쓸어요 / 쓸어서 / 쓸면).
Transitive verb (包裝하다 = wrap / pack / package; take out food); accusative -을/를 (상자를 포장하다, 선물 포장); food service: 포장해 주세요 (please pack it to-go).
Transitive verb (申請하다 = apply for / sign up / register for); takes accusative -을/를 (비자를 신청하다, 수강 신청을 하다); stem 신청하- -> 신청해요 / 신청해서.
Transitive verb (計算하다 = calculate / compute / settle the bill / pay); collocations: 음식값을 계산하다, 카드로 계산해 주세요, 계산대 (cashier / checkout counter).
Transitive verb; strong collocation with teeth (이를 닦다 = brush teeth), hands/surfaces (손/바닥을 닦다).
Transitive verification verb (確認하다 = check / confirm / verify); accusative -을/를 (예약/시간/신분증/문자를 확인하다); stem 확인하- -> 확인해요 / 확인해서.
Transitive: takes source with -에게서/한테서 (person) or -에서 (institution/place) and theme with -을/를 (도서관에서 책을 빌리다).
Transitive/intransitive cleaning verb; takes room/facility as direct object (방/교실/집을 청소하다).
Transmission verb (傳 + 하다 = to deliver / convey / pass along); takes message or object with -을/를 and recipient with -에게 (안부를 전하다, 서류를 전하다).
Transportation/ride verb: collocates with vehicles (버스, 지하철, 택시, 자전거) and board sports (스키, 스노보드, 스케이트). Takes accusative -을/를.
Travel agency commercial facility (旅行社); takes locative -에서 with 비행기표/패키지를 예약하다.
Travel duration bound numeral compound (泊...日 = [Number] nights and [Number] days); takes Sino-Korean numerals: 1박 2일, 2박 3일, 3박 4일 여행.
Travel noun (旅行); collocates with 가다 (여행을 가다 = go on a trip), 떠나다 (depart), and 계획을 세우다.
Travel souvenir noun (紀念品 = souvenir / memento); counter 개; collocations: 기념품 가게 (souvenir shop), 여행 기념품을 사다.
Traversing motion verb ('to cross'); takes path with accusative -을/를 (길/다리/횡단보도를 건너다).
Trend predicate (流行 + 이다 = to be in fashion / popular / trending); collocates with 요즘 유행이다, 유행을 따르다.
Underground pedestrian walkway (地下道); collocates with 내려가다 and 건너다.
Underground/basement noun (地下); combines with 층 for basement levels (지하 1층 = B1).
Universal completive adverb ('all / completely'); placed immediately before verb predicate (다 먹었어요, 다 왔어요).
Universal free-choice particle (-(이)든지 = 'any / whichever / no matter what'); consonant takes 이든지 (무엇이든지, 책이든지), vowel takes 든지 (누구든지, 언제든지, 사과든지); often paired with interrogative pronouns.
Universal quantifier noun/adverb ('all / everyone / everything'); synonymous with 다.
University language institute noun (韓國語學堂 = Korean Language Institute / Language Academy); collocations: 한국어학당에 다니다 / 입학하다 (attend/enroll in language institute), 연세/서울대 한국어학당; locative -에 / -에서.
Unpleasantly chilly/nippy weather adjective (late autumn / early spring); negative temperature nuance.
Upward motion verb ('to go up / ascend'); antonym of 내려가다. Takes destination with -에 / -로 (2층으로 올라가다).
Urban geography noun (都市 = city / urban area); collocates with 대도시 (metropolis), 시골 (countryside - antonym).
Urgency adjective (急하다 = urgent / pressing / hasty / impatient); collocates with 급한 일 (urgent matter), 성격이 급하다 (impatient), 마음이 급하다.
Utility bill / public charges noun (公課金 = taxes and public utilities, e.g. electricity, water, gas); collocations: 공과금을 내다 / 납부하다 (pay utility bills).
Utility/convenience adjective (便利하다 = convenient / handy); collocates with 교통 (교통이 편리하다), 생활; antonym is 불편하다.
Utility/physical adjective (不便하다 = inconvenient / uncomfortable / physically ailing); antonym is 편리하다 / 편하다; collocates with 교통이 불편하다, 몸이 불편하다.
Vacation rental cottage/villa loanword; collocates with 묵다 and 예약하다.
Variant of 그저께. Cannot take time particle -에 (*그제에 is ungrammatical). Requires past tense.
Vehicle collocation: pairs with car/vehicle objects (차를 운전하다)
Vehicle facility noun (注油所 = petrol/gas station); collocates with 기름을 넣다 (to pump gas), 주유소에 들르다.
Vehicle loanword noun (autobike / motorcycle); counter 대; paired with verb 타다 (오토바이를 타다 = ride a motorbike); collocations: 오토바이 헬멧.
Vehicle loanword noun (rent-a-car = rental automobile); counter 대; collocations: 렌터카를 빌리다 / 대여하다 (hire a rental car), 렌터카를 운전하다.
Vehicle parking facility noun (駐車場 = parking lot / parking garage); locative -에/-에서 (주차장에 차를 세우다/대다).
Vehicle placement verb (駐車 + 하다 = to park a car); takes vehicle with -을/를 and location with -에 (차를 주차장에 주차하다).
Verbal nominalizing constructions: verb stem + -기 and verb stem + -는 것 ('doing X / to do X'); allows clauses to take case particles (한국어 배우기가 재미있어요).
Verbal noun (取消 = cancellation / nullification); forms active 취소하다 (cancel) and passive 취소되다 (be cancelled); collocates with 예약 취소 (reservation cancellation).
Verbal response verb (對答 + 하다 = to answer / reply); takes query with allative/dative -에 (질문에 대답하다); nominal form is 대답; antonym is 질문하다.

Versatile intransitive change-of-state verb: (1) become: complement takes -이/가 되다 (선생님이 되다 = become a teacher); (2) time passage: 시간이 되다 (time is up), 1년이 되다 (it has been a year); (3) permission: -아/어도 되다 (may do); (4) function/work: 잘 되다 (go well); stem 되- -> 돼요 / 돼서 / 됩니다.
Visual perspective noun (展望 = scenic view / vantage / vista; economic outlook); collocations: 전망이 좋다 / 아름답다, 오션 뷰 / 바다 전망, 전망대 (observatory).
Voice noun (목 + 소리); collocates with 크다/작다 (목소리가 크다/작다 = loud/quiet voice), 좋다, 낮다/높다.
Volitional commitment/promise ending: restricted strictly to 1st person subject in statements (cannot be used in questions or with 2nd/3rd person subjects).

Volitional decision / mutual resolution construction (verb stem + -기로 하다 = 'decide to / agree to / plan to do X'); frequently used in past tense -기로 했다 (내일 만나기로 했어요, 여행을 가기로 했어요); attaches directly to Action verb stems.
Volitional future plan construction: verb stem + -(으)ㄹ 거예요 ('will / going to'); 1st person subject in statements (내일 갈 거예요). Spacing: bound noun 거 + 예요.
Volitional intention pre-final suffix in formal/polite registers ('I will / I intend to'); restricted to 1st person subject in statements (제가 하겠습니다, 끝까지 노력하겠다).
Vowel harmony past marker: stems with bright vowels (ㅏ, ㅗ) take -았어요; dark/other vowels take -었어요; 하다 verbs become 했어요.
Waiting queue ticket noun (番號票 = waiting number slip/ticket); strongly collocates with verb 뽑다 (번호표를 뽑다 = take a number ticket) at banks and government offices.
Waste noun ('trash / garbage / rubbish'); collocates with 버리다 (쓰레기를 버리다), 줍다, 분리수거.
Watercraft noun (ship/boat); maritime counter is 척. Takes 타다 (배를 타다). Homonym with stomach, pear, fold/times.

Wearable / fastening verb taking accusative -을/를; used for tied accessories: 넥타이를 매다 (wear a necktie), 안전벨트를 매다 (fasten seatbelt), 끈을 매다; homophone with distinct spelling from 메다 (to shoulder/carry a backpack).
Wearable accessory noun (掌匣 = gloves / mittens); selectional restriction: takes wearable verb 끼다 (장갑을 끼다/벗다); counter: 켤레 (pair).
Wearable accessory verb ('to wear on wrist'); takes watch or bracelet with accusative -을/를 (시계를 차다, 팔찌를 차다); conjugates 차요 / 차서 / 찹니다.
Wearable action verb ('to carry on shoulder / sling across shoulder'); selectional restriction: strictly takes bags, backpacks, rifles (가방/배낭을 메다); contrast with 매다 (tie tie/shoelace: 넥타이/신발끈을 매다).
Wearable action verb ('to wear on head or face'); selectional restriction: strictly takes headwear and eyewear (모자를 쓰다, 안경을 쓰다, 마스크를 쓰다, 우산을 쓰다).
Wearable verb taking accusative -을/를 for digits, hands, or eyes (장갑/반지를 끼다); conjugates 껴요 / 껴서 / 낍니다.
Weather forecast noun (日氣豫報); collocates with 확인하다, 보다, 듣다.
Weather noun: pairs with weather adjectives (덥다, 춥다, 좋다, 나쁘다)
Wedding loanword noun ('bridal bouquet'); collocates with 부케를 던지다/받다.
Winter season noun; takes time particle -에 (겨울에). Collocates with 춥다, 눈이 오다, and 겨울방학.
Winter snowball fight VP; takes comitative partner with -와/과 or -하고 (친구들과 눈싸움을 하다).
Winter sports item; collocates strictly with 타다 (스케이트를 타다). Venue takes 스케이트장.
Winter sports item; collocates strictly with 타다 (스키를 타다). Venue takes 스키장.
Work arrival/commute verb (出勤 + 하다); antonym of 퇴근하다 (leave work). Takes time particle -에 (9시에 출근하다).
Work/employee leave noun (休暇); contrasts with school vacation 방학. Collocates with 휴가를 내다/가다.
Workplace departure verb (退勤 + 하다 = to clock out / leave work); antonym is 출근하다 (to go to work); collocates with 칼퇴근 (leaving right on time).
Workplace document noun (書類 = official papers / documents); counter: 장, 통; collocates with 서류를 제출하다/검토하다/전하다.
Workplace/job noun (職場); collocates with 직장에 다니다 and 직장 동료 (coworker).
Written note loanword noun ('memo / brief note'); counter: 장; collocates with 메모를 하다/남기다 (take/leave a note), 메모지.
Written reply noun (答狀 = written answer / reply letter / text reply); paired with verbs: 답장을 보내다 / 쓰다 / 받다; 답장하다 (to reply).
Zoological pet noun ('puppy / young dog'); counter: 마리; collocates with 강아지를 키우다/산책시키다.
ㄷ-irregular verb: stem final ㄷ alternates to ㄹ before vowels (걸어요, 걸으면, 걸어서). Intransitive motion verb.
ㄷ-irregular verb: stem final ㄷ alternates to ㄹ before vowels (물어요, 물으면). Takes dative -에게/한테 (선생님께 묻다). Often compounded as 물어보다.
ㄷ-irregular verb: stem final ㄷ alternates to ㄹ before vowels (실어요, 실으면). Transitive: takes direct object and locative destination -에 (차에 짐을 싣다).
ㄹ-irregular adjective (힘들어요, 힘듭니다, 힘든). Subject can be an activity/situation or person (일이 힘들다 / 내가 힘들다).
르-irregular adjective (달라요, 달라서); antonym of 같다. Takes comparison entity with -와/과 다르다 (이것과 달라요).
르-irregular adjective: stem inserts additional ㄹ before vowel endings (빨라요, 빨라서). Antonym of 느리다.
르-irregular cognitive verb (몰라요, 몰라서); antonym of 알다. Governs embedded interrogative clauses (-(으)ㄴ/는지 모르다).
르-irregular transitive verb (잘라요, 잘라서); collocates with hair (머리를 자르다), food, paper, and physical severance.
르-irregular verb (불러요, 불러서). Polysemous: (1) sing (노래를 부르다), (2) call out/summon (이름/택시를 부르다).
르-irregular verb: stem doubles ㄹ before vowels (골라요, 골라서). Transitive: takes accusative -을/를 (선물을 고르다).
ㅂ-irregular adjective: stem final ㅂ alternates to 우 before vowels (가벼워요, 가벼우면). Antonym of 무겁다.
ㅂ-irregular adjective: stem final ㅂ alternates to 우 before vowels (두꺼워요, 두꺼우면). Collocates with books and clothing; antonym of 얇다.
ㅂ-irregular adjective: stem final ㅂ alternates to 우 before vowels (무거워요, 무거우면). Antonym of 가볍다.
ㅂ-irregular adjective: stem final ㅂ alternates to 우 before vowels (반가워요, 반가우면). Formulaic greeting: 만나서 반갑습니다.
ㅂ-irregular adjective: stem final ㅂ alternates to 우 before vowels (쉬워요, 쉬우면). Antonym is 어렵다.
ㅂ-irregular adjective: stem final ㅂ alternates to 우 before vowels (어려워요, 어려우면). Antonym is 쉽다.
ㅂ-irregular distance adjective (가까워요, 가까우면); antonym of 멀다. Takes reference place with -에서 가깝다.
ㅂ-irregular emotion adjective (즐거워요, 즐거우면); standard greeting: 즐거운 주말 보내세요.
ㅂ-irregular humble verb for 묻다 (여쭤요, 여쭈면); takes addressee with -께 (교수님께 여쭙다).
ㅂ-irregular verb: stem final ㅂ alternates to 오 before -아요 (도와요), and to 우 before other vowel suffixes (도우면, 도왔어요). Takes accusative -을/를 for person.
ㅡ-irregular adjective (아파요, 아파서). Takes body part with nominative -이/가 (머리가 아프다, 배가 아프다).
ㅡ-irregular verb (꺼요, 껐어요); antonym of 켜다. Collocates with electrical devices (컴퓨터, 전화) and lights/fire (불).
